sanskrit: kathaṃ vijñāyate śaṃbho etadicchāmi veditum varṇamantra padādhvā ca kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ bhuvanādhvā tu yatprokto mayā pūrvaṃ hi suvrate punaścāṣṭādaśaistatvaiḥ kalābhedaiḥ punasthitam tatsarvañcāṣṭabhirbhedairākṣiptaṃ punareva tu ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulañcāraṃ yanmayā kathitaṃ tava āpādatalamadhvānamutsaheta varānane tattvādhvā ca varārohe teṣāñcordhvaṃ vyavasthitaḥ kalādhvā tu sa eveti kathitastatra pūrvaśaḥ ṣaṭtṛṃśāṅgulaṃ parityajya kramavacca sumadhyame svāmibhāvaṃ tu yattasmin dvādaśāntamavasthitaḥ śaktyā dehasthito hyātmā niṣkalaḥ parameśvaraḥ susamiddhe yathā vahnau śikhālihati cāṃbare dīkṣākāle'bhimānantu tadvat kuryāttu deśikaḥ śaktyāraṇibhūtāyā punastatra kṣipāmyaham atītaśśiva tadvahneḥ sa tu yojayate pare udite tu pare tatve tatrastho'pi na vāryate līnassarvagato devi dharmādharma vivarjitaḥ yāvadvaktramanuprāptaṃ dvibhāgaṃ tyajate tu saḥ atītaṃ dvādaśānte tu śaktipadmaṃ prakīrtitam niṣkalaśśaktipadme tu prabuddhastatra tiṣṭhati na kālaṃ na kalācāraṃ na tatvā na ca devatā taṃ prāpya na nivartante bhayasaṃsārabandhane etatte niṣkalaṃ tatvamuktameva samāsataḥ trividhaṃ tu parityajya śaktyantaṃ yastṛṭi smṛtaḥ

sa bhoktā sarvatatvānāṃ śaktyante yastṛṭismṛtaḥ śaktyatīto varārohe tatvena saha yujyate tatra śakticatuṣkantu sūkṣmākhyaṃ parikīrtitam sarvatantreṣu sāmānyaṃ tatrasthaṃ viṣuvaṃ smṛtam sakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva mayanañca tṛtīyakam tribhāgabhājite cāre niṣkalaḥ praṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ sa cetasya smṛto jīvo yadā śaktyā tu yujyate cinmātrantu smṛto hutvā cetā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā sarvatantreṣu sāmānyaṃ tantrasthe viṣuvaṃ vadet tathā yuktamidaṃ sarvaṃ nānāceṣṭāni kārayet kalpanārahitaṃ jñāṃ sarvatatvavivarjitam etatte niṣkalañcāraṃ kathitantu mayākhilam kapaṭenopapannāya śravasyapi na dāpayet mūrtidevasya vikhyātā śaktyā devabhuvasya tu brahmādīnāṃ varārohe śūnyadehaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ śaktyavasthāntarī bhūtāssūkṣmādyāḥ parikīrtitāḥ tṛtīyā tu varārohe jñātavyā deśikena tu ta evamanurūpantu pañcamāṃ kathitaṃ tava trividhaṃ mantradehantu veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca mantrarūpaṃ tathaiveha kathitaṃ tatvato mayā pañcabrahmāṇi deveśi veditavyāni yatnataḥ tatvarūpaṃ tathaiveha pañcabrahmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ vrajate śivasāyujyaṃ śivena sahamodate veditavyaṃ prayatnena siddhimokṣārthakāṅkṣibhiḥ

yena vijñātamātreṇa vidhimuktaṃ labheddhṛvam śabdavyomatayā jyotiḥ vigraho bhuvanastathā mantramūrtiṃ viditvā tu mantrasiddhimavāpnuyāt brahmādīnāṃ surendrāṇāṃ sādhane vigrahaṃ smaret śabdatatve pare līnaḥ śabdāntargatamānasaḥ tasyātītaṃ paraṃ devi śaktivyomaprakīrtitam vigraho bhuvano jyotiḥ śabdacchāmantathaiva ca śivamevaṃ vidhaṃ jñātvā sādhakastu samāhitaḥ mantramūrtiparaṃ jñātvā siddhiṃ muktimāpnuyāt bhuvanantu bhuvanākāraṃ brahmāṇḍādi yathākramam indranīlamahānīlaiḥ rājataiśca vibhūṣitam divyasṛggandhavastrāḍhyaṃ divyaiśvaryasamanvitam vigrahaṃ vigrahākāraṃ śivavarṇādilakṣaṇam śūnyahastaṃ vṛṣārūḍhamumādehārdhasaṃyutam vigrahaṃ devadevasya sarvakāmārthasādhanam jyotidhyānātsadāyogī yogasiddhimavāpnuyāt vyālākāramanākāraṃ vyomavyāpī paraśśivaḥ nirguṇaṃ sāñjanātītaṃ gṛhanakṣatravarjitam vyomalīnamanāḥ samyak vyomastho vyomatanmayaḥ śabdadhyānāt paromokṣaḥ siddhayaśca na saṃśayaḥ vāmapārśve iḍā tasya ciñciṇīśabdamuttamam dakṣiṇena suṣumnā hi ciravyakrinī smṛtā ghaṇṭānādavirāmāntāntyamadhyaparaṃ smṛtam ciñciṇīcāravakyante nirālaṃbo nirāśrayaḥ hṛdisthaṃ mantrasaṅghātaṃ kṛtvā mūrtinyasedbudhaḥ

sa tu cintayate nityaṃ tatrasthaṃ bindumīśvaram haṃsākhyaścaiva binduśca nādo nādānta eva ca etattatparamaṃ guhyametattatparamaṃ śivam etattatparamaṃ jñānametattatparamākṣaram vidite saṃyagevaṃ hi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ eteṣāṃ parato devaḥ śabdarūpavivarjitaḥ taṃ viditvā vimucyante sidhyante nātra saṃśayaḥ kathaṃ vijñāyate śaṃbho ratiguhyataraṃ param tasyāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi lakṣaṇantu surārcite divārātryośca madhye tu veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ pañcadhā tu parityajya praśāntaṃ śūnyamucyate nāsāyāntu yadātītaṃ tacchūnyañca tṛtīyakam ayanaṃ śūnyamityuktaṃ kathitaṃ jñānamuttamam adhastāttu parityajya pañcadhā parameśvari etatpraśāntaśūnyantu jñātvā mucyeta bandhanāt viditaṃ tadvarārohe dehamuktamidaṃ smṛtam ūrdhvaśūnyamadhaśśūnyaṃ madhyaśśūnyaṃ tṛtīyakam sā mayā kathitā hyete caturthantu nirāmayam tena doṣāya vartante śeṣaṃ mahānulakṣaṇam na tasya kalpanā devi pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthitaḥ kriyātītantu tattatvaṃ gīyate sarvataśśubhe evaṃ triśūnyabhedantu kathitaṃ tava suvṛte na tasya kalpanā devi pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthitaḥ kriyātītantu tattatvaṃ gīyate sarvataśśubhe evaṃ triśūnyabhedantu kathitaṃ tava suvrate

tena jñātena saṃjñeyī dīkṣānugrahakṛt bhavet pañcavyomāḥ purā proktāḥ te tvayā viditāḥ śubhe brahmāṇamāditaḥ kṛtvā yāvaddevaḥ sadāśivaḥ ekaikaṃ pañcadhā devi veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ svabhāvavarṇato devi jñeyaṃ vijñāyate yathā aṇavastrayamākhyātaṃ hṛtkarṇaṃ tālumāśritam brahmāviṣṇastathā rudra abhāvaḥ sūtravatsmṛtāḥ tacchabdo nāda ityuktaḥ sa jīvaḥ kathitastava tatkṣayena na kiñcit syāt guruvaktraṃ saducyate mantrāstathaiva jñātavyā deśikena mahātmanā śrūyate ucyate caiva śivaśaktiviceṣṭitam sidhyate nātra sandehaḥ śivaśaktyupabṛṃhitaḥ mantrāstasya na sidhyanti na ca yāti paraṃ padam kathitaṃ tatra sadbhāvaṃ tanmayā viditaṃ prabho ke ca kasmin gṛhādeva dīkṣitā devadānavāḥ yakṣarākṣasabhūtāśca piśācoragakinnarā svāntena dīkṣitādeva yasya siddhi dhruvaṃ bhavet koṭibhedāḥ samākhyātāḥ śākhābhedāśca śaṅkara śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tantrabhedamanuttamam dīkṣitāni mayā yasmin na śaṅkāśca yathā purā prakāśitaṃ purā devi mamedaṃ parameṣṭhinā saṃhartā ca na sandehaḥ mantramūrtiḥ paraśśivaḥ dīkṣāvidhiniyogañca kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yathāśrutam tasyādirbhagavān devaśśivo vai mantramūrtimān tena prakāśitaṃ pūrvaṃ śivenānandamūrtimān

mayāpi tatvadeveśi tvayā dattaṃ pitāmahe viṣṇunāpi hutāśāya tena dattantu vāyave sūryeṇa cāpi somāya kathitaṃ punareva tu evaṃ taddaśadhā jñānaṃ śivoktaṃ tatra saṅgrahe sa eva jagataścāsya mantramūrtirmaheśvaraḥ prāpyate devadeveśi mokṣañca bhuvi durlabham lokodbhaveti rudreṇa punareva prakīrtitam kāraṇaṃ bhagavān brahmā ajiteti janārdanaḥ sahasrāṃśeti dharmāya aṃśumāniti bhāskaraḥ śivaśaktimadhiṣṭhāya vibhinnaṃ vai punasthitaḥ evameti surāssarve śivajñānasya pāragāḥ asyaiva jñānamukhyasya śivajñānasya sāṃpṛtam aṣṭādaśavidhairbhedaiḥ tatra bhedaiḥ punasthitaḥ tasya bhedā bhavantyete saṃjñā ca parikīrtyate vijayaṃ prathamaṃ teṣāṃ niśvāsaṃ tadanantaram vīrabhadramiti khyātaṃ rauravaṃ mākuṭaṃ tathā prodgītaṃ lalitañcaiva siddhisantānameva ca īśvaraḥ prathamaḥ prokto devī ca tadanantaram nandīśvaro mahākāla īśānaṃ candramāstathā lalitā caiva caṇḍaśca śāntapāṇī tathaiva ca vijayamīśvarajñānaṃ devyā niśvāsasaṃhitām vīreṇa vīrabhadrastu nandīrauravameva ca candramāścandrabhāsañca jñānañcāṅgirasaṃ tathā lalitaṃ lalitā devi daṇḍahastaṃ tathaiva ca kiraṇaṃ brahmaṇā caiva parameśe pārameśvaram

te cāpyante mahābhāgāḥ kramārādyāśśacīpatiḥ mantrabheda praṇetāro mantrakalpakarāstathā nāmabhedaprasaṃkhyātamārādhya parameśvaram gaṇaguhyakabhedaiśca rudrabhedaiśca saṃjñitam punaścaiva samākhyātā naṣṭā daśavidhāstathā tasmin mantrāḥ samākhyātāḥ śrūyatāṃ varavarṇinī ekapañcāśatañcaiva tathā vai saptasaptatiḥ vijaye tu samākhyātaṃ tasmin brahmā tu dīkṣitaḥ aṣṭau caiva tu lakṣāṇi daśabhirmaṇḍalaisthitam śukraḥ kubero varuṇo yamaścaivāśvināvapi niśvāse tu pare tantre kathitaṃ tava śobhane śatamekaṃ tathā cānyaṃ mantrāṇāṃ parisaṃkhyayā saptavidyādharaṃ tantraṃ tathā svāyaṃbhuveti ca prajānāṃ patayaścaiva tathā brahmasutāśca ye yakṣarākṣasagandharvāḥ piśācoragakinnarāḥ sahasramekaṃ mantrāṇāṃ triṃśadbhirmaṇḍalaiḥ sthitam gātarodhe gṛhāścaiva ye ca vighnādayo gaṇāḥ ekādaśa sahasrāṇi koṭitrīṇi ca saṃgrahe aṣṭādaśa vidhairbhedaiḥ loke mantragaṇān bahūn visarpitañca saṃbodhaiḥ kūṭamudbhūtakāraṇaiḥ atra te ṛṣayaṃssiddhāḥ balakhilyāstapodhanāḥ anena caiva siddhānte devā vai mānavādayaḥ koṭirekaṃ sahasrañca mantramaṇḍalaviṃśakam pañcamantraśatā jñeyāḥ caturmūrtivyavasthitāḥ nalāntarmātṛkalpaiśca ṛṣibhiḥ sevyate sadā

maṇḍalāṣṭakasaṃyuktaṃ visarannāmanāmataḥ daśabhedāḥ samākhyātāḥ candrabhāsamiti smṛtam ekamaṇḍalagūḍhantu nārasihmeti viśrutam mayādyā nalinaścaiva nalinādyāśca yatra vai mantrairdvādaśabhiryuktaṃ maṇḍaladvayasaṃyutam dvisahasre śate dve ca maṇḍāśca trisaptatiḥ yogināṃ paramo yatra mantrabhedaḥ pravartate trayastriṃśatsamāyuktaṃ vidyāśaktiviceṣṭitam mahāvratavidhānañca dīkṣāvidhisamudbhavaḥ nāḍīsañcārasaṃyuktaṃ lalitaṃ pañcamaṃ calam daśadhā maṇḍalākhyātaṃ siddhamityeva saṃjñitam koṭidvayantu mantrāṇāṃ śatānāṃ parikīrtitam trimaṇḍalamathājñeyaṃ gūḍhadevaistu kīrtitam maṇḍalānāṃ śatañcaiva śarvodgītamiti smṛtam kiraṇe hi samākhyātamādityo yatra dīkṣitaḥ koṭisaptasamākhyātaṃ mantrāṇāṃ niyutaṃ tathā saṃkhyātā mantrabhedāśca śākhābhedāśca tatvataḥ śivaproktā smṛtāṃhyete tantrakalpabahu smṛtāḥ *? tatvaṃ yāti saṃjñāśca vidyātatvaṃ śivātmakam gandharva yakṣarakṣāśca piśācā ṛṣayastathā mantrajāpena siddhāstu sarve te sādhakāḥ smṛtāḥ idaṃ sāramidaṃ sāraṃ yassarvaṃ jñātumicchati vijñāyākṣaratanmātraṃ gurumārādhya yatnataḥ tatprasādādbhavenmuktiḥ saṃsārabhavabandhanāt tatvamācakṣva deveśa yadi syādvarado mama

yatra tatvañca deveśa utkrāntisiddhisādhanam tena sarvamidaṃ kāryaṃ tena sarvamidaṃ tatam kasmin kasmin pradeśe tu draṣṭavyaṃ bindumīśvaram nādañcaiva tathā śaktiḥ hṛllakṣasya ca darśanam śṛṇu devi paraṃ guhyaṃ rahasyamidamuttamam navātmakena sarveśi yathā bhavati tacchṛṇu nādaṃ tasya śikhā proktā śaktistu paramaṃ sthitā guruvakrācca labhyeta yathā tenaiva coditaḥ yathā karmāṇi kurute kathayāmi tavākhilam anādiparamaṃ jñānaṃ anādi paramavyayam yathā prāpsyasi tannādaṃ binduśca bhuvi durlabham bhruvormadhye samākhyātaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvara varjitaṃ darśatatvaiśca darśatatvaprakāśakam dīpau tasya samākhyātau ubhau tau śaśi bhāskarau iḍā dṛśyati vāmena suṣumnā dakṣiṇena tu ghaṭamadhye yathā dīpaḥ tadghaṭaṃ vai prakāśate yathā'darśo malairgrastaḥ pratibiṃbaṃ na dṛśyate ubhayorapi pāṇibhyāṃ dhārasaṃsthāpya buddhimān nāsā śrotraṃ tathā cakṣuḥ ubhayorapicchādayet chādanāt tyajyate binduḥ śuddhasphaṭikanirmalaḥ śabdanādavinirmuktaṃ dhyātavyaṃ paramaṃ śivam yathā sarvagato vāyuṃ pīṭhastho na ca dṛśyate araṇistho yathā vahniḥ vidyamāno na dṛśyate saṃyogena tathā binduḥ pratyakṣo dṛśyate tadā tadvat sarvagato binduḥ yogahīno na dṛśyate

prāpyate ca tathā binduḥ yogināñca mahātmanām prakāśayati tattoyaṃ ātmakīḍena tejasā tadvadyogavihīnasya binduścaiva na dṛśyate dhyānaṃ yogaṃ samākhyāya paśyate bindumīśvaram paratvādaparaṃ nāsti nityayuktaṃ sadā bhavet kathitaṃ sa rahasyantu jñātavyaṃ yogibhissadā vijñeyā ca sadā devi śikhā tasyaiva madhyataḥ tallayassatataṃ yogī lakṣayetsusamāhitaḥ nava tatvāni deveśi yānyuktāni navātmake ādihuṅkārasaṃyuktaḥ saptaite bhuvidurlabhāḥ sadyassaṅkrāmaṇantyete ekameva niyojitāḥ hākārarūpasaṃyogāt cintyamānastu sotkramāt akārādimakārāntā makārokārayojitāḥ etāssaptasamākhyātāḥ kṣurikāḥ prāṇahārikāḥ saptānāntu samākhyātamaṣṭa oṅkāra ucyate oṅkāraṃ sarvadevatyaṃ sarvavyāpī paraśśivaḥ tatra cotpadyate śaṃbhuḥ śabdātītastu niṣkalaḥ nānāmārgasthito vyāpī sarvalokasya durlabhaḥ hṛdaye caiva karṇe ca bhruvormadhye tathaiva ca turyadvāramiti proktaṃ devayānamiti smṛtam devatānāṃ trayañcaiva śaktitrayamiti smṛtam sarvagaḥ sarvato vyāpī sarvamāpūryatiṣṭhati padmasya karṇikāmadhye brahmā tatra vyavasthitaḥ tālujihvamiti khyātaṃ dvitīyaṃ sthānamucyate lavaṃ kasya tu tatsthānaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane

mūrdhni sthānaṃ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ mokṣamārgapradāyakam taṃ jñātvā mucyate jantuḥ bhavetsaṃsārabandhanāt evaṃ vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ vāṅmayaṃ sa carācaram hṛdayaṃ dehamadhye tu tatra padmaṃ vyavasthitam tasya madhye viniṣkrāntaṃ nādaṃ paramadurlabham turyadvāraviniṣkrāntaṃ dvayantasya vicintayet eṣa śabdassamākhyāto mokṣamārgapradāyakam dhyānena tu kimanyena tapasogreṇa vā punaḥ vidante nādasadbhāve bindudeve ca śobhane athāpi dīpadehastu ākāśe tu yathā śivā evaṃ sūkṣmāti sūkṣmasya nādatatvasya nirṇayaḥ sūryaraśmisahasrābhā madhye nāḍī prakīrtitā sā nāḍī sarvaśabdānāṃ tatvānāñcaiva śobhane sūkṣmā ca sarvagā caiva jñātvā jñānī vimucyate sūryamaṇḍalamadhye tu akārastu vyavasthitaḥ makāreti ca vikhyāto bhitvā nādo layaṃ sthitaḥ layaṃ tasya tu deveśe yatrāsau paramaśśivaḥ hṛllakṣaḥ paramo jñeyo yogināñca tathaiva hi hrāsahrāsavibhāgena nānāsiddhiphalapradā caturakṣaraṃ vijānīyāt * * * * * * * ? saṃpūrṇaḥ śiva ityuktaḥ sa eva parameśvari hṛdayādi samuddiṣṭā jñātavyāstu varānane hṛllakṣadarśanaṃ devi acirādeva jāyate śca tathaiva ca dhyāyamāno varārohe bījadīpena bodhitaḥ

kṛṣṇaśuklāṃstathā cānyān paśyate raktavarṇakān jvalate hṛdi padme tu nijadīpasubo * * ? jvalate dīptavaddevi hṛdayaṃ nijadīpitam jvalate bhagavān binduḥ dīpasyordhvaśikhopamaḥ yathā kaviḥ kathitaṃ te mahājñānaṃ sarvajñāneṣu cottamam suvarṇena sahaikatvaṃ gacchate nātra saṃśayaḥ śivena ca saṃhaikatvaṃ gacchate * * * * * ? daśāhānnaparaṃ laṅghet paśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ hitāya sa * * * * * * * ? tava śobhane āsanaṃ kalpya deveśi tatra nyāsantu kārayet ekanāvaraṇenaiva pūjanīyo maheśvaraḥ evaṃ pūjya yathā nyāyaṃ japedhyāyetprayogavit tattatprāpnotyayatnena sādhako nātra saṃśayaḥ ādyamadhye tu ye tatvāḥ kathayāmi yathākramam tasmin sarvamaśeṣantu vidhiṃ kuryādvarānane prakṛtirvinyasenmadhye mūrtinā sahasaṃyutam anantaṃ hṛdayaṃ tasya vyomarūpaṃ śirasmṛtam anāsitābhavedastaṃ śivāṅgāḥ parikīrtitāḥ īkārantu śivā devi ākāraṃ kavacaṃ viduḥ brahmāṇamastradaivatyaṃ kavacaṃ viṣṇudaivatam śivā tu devadeveśi tvameva parikīrtitā puruṣaṃ pūrvatonyasya āgneyyāṃ niyatiṃ nyaset vidyā paścimataḥ proktā īśvaraṃ vāyugocare śivatatvaṃ paraṃ śuddhamīśānyaṃ parikalpayet

svatatvaṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā yaṣṭavyāni dine dine śivāṅgā ye janāḥ proktāḥ karṇikāyāṃ vyavasthitāḥ eṣa eva vidhirdeviḥ prakṛtyādi śivāntikāḥ uttiṣṭhantardhāne ca pādacāre tathaiva ca guḍikākāśagamane dantakāṣṭhe pavitrake pūrvasūtreṇa tu ye proktāḥ tatsarvaṃ labhate naraḥ punaśca śṛṇu deveśi yajanaṃ kathayāmi te sakalīkṛtya deveśi niṣkalena śivaṃ smaret sakalaṃ hṛdayaṃ devi sakalāḍhyaṃ śirasmṛtam kṣayāntamastramityuktaṃ śivāṅgāḥ parikīrtitāḥ vidyāṅgāste tu vijñeyāḥ pūrvasūtre tu ye smṛtāḥ dakṣiṇena śikhāṃ dadyāt kavacaṃ paścimena tu vidyāṅgā hṛdayaṃ devi āgneyyāṃ parikalpayet dvitīyāvaraṇe mantratatvāni parikalpayet eṣate kathyate devi tatvānāṃ yajanaṃ prati evaṃ yaṣṭvā tu tatvāni japeccaiva navātmakam manasā cintitaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpādayati mantriṇaḥ dvirāvaraṇametaddhi yajanaṃ samudāhṛtam tribhirāvaraṇaistatvānyaṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyāt garbhāvaraṇametaddhi kartavyaṃ surasundari evaṃ tatvagaṇān devi yaṣṭvā siddhimavāpnuyāt yaṃ yaṣṭvā sidhyate mantraṃ mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ nānena sadṛśaṃ yāgaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate pañcabrahma śivāṅgaiśca garbhametattu kalpayet pūrvasūtre tu yatproktā aṅgāścaiva navātmake

navātmapañcabhirbhedaiḥ yanmayā parikīrtitam evaṃ yaṣṭvā tato mantrī japayogaṃ samārabhet budhvā smṛtvā ca mucyante sādhakājjanmabandhanāt yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ kathayāmi tavākhilam nyāsamātreṇa mucyante sādhakājjanmabandhanāt paramākṣaraṃ nyasettatra karṇikāyāntu mantriṇā paramākṣarasya yogoyamevaṃ te samudāhṛtam pūrvapatre punardevi vinyasetparamākṣaram kalāḍhyaṃ naiṛte caiva khamalaṃ paścime tathā īśānyāṃ vinyasenmantrī kaṇṭhoṣṭhaṃ parameśvari āgneyyāṃ niṣkalaṃ tatra karṇikāyāntu vinyaset dakṣiṇe śūnyatatvantu kalāḍhyaṃ nair-ṛtena tu kṣayāntamuttareṇaiva kaṇṭhoṣṭhaṃ naiśagocare dakṣiṇe karṇikāyāntu śūnyatatvantu vinyaset paramākṣaraṃ nyaseddevi dakṣiṇe samudāhṛtam kṣapaṇaṃ vāyudeśe tu vinyasetsamudāhṛtam nair-ṛte karṇikāyāntu kalāḍhyaṃ vinyasecchubhe śūnyaṃ dakṣiṇato nyasya nair-ṛtyāṃ paramākṣaram kṣayāntamuttareṇaiva kaṇṭhoṣṭhamīśagocare paścime karṇikāyāntu khamalaḥ parikīrtitaḥ dakṣiṇe śūnyatatvantu kalāḍhyaṃ nair-ṛtena tu vāyavyāṃ kṣapaṇaṃ caiva kṣayāntañcottareṇa tu vāyavyāṃ karṇikāyāntu kṣapaṇaḥ parikīrtitaḥ śūnyañca dakṣiṇe caiva kalāḍhyaṃ naiṛtena tu uttare tu kṣayāntañca kaṇṭhoṣṭhyamīśagocare

uttare karṇikāpīṭhe kṣayāntaṃ tatvavinyaset dakṣiṇe śūnyamityuktaṃ kalāḍhyaṃ naiṛtena tu paramākṣarantu deveśi uttareṇa tu vinyaset saptamaṃ te samākhyātaṃ tatvaṃ sukharārcite pūrvapatre tu sakalamāgneyyāṃ niṣkalaṃ param khamalaṃ paścime caiva kṣapaṇaṃ vāyugocare aṣṭamaṃ te samākhyātaṃ pīṭhaṃ paramadurlabham na mayā kasyacitkhyāta yāga eṣa sudurlabhaḥ vrajate śivasāyujyaṃ nirmalo vigatajvaraḥ pañcāṃśena śatenaiva dīkṣāṃ kurvīta deśikaḥ kartavyaṃ deśikendreṇa homakarma yathākramam svacittasyānusāreṇa yajanantu samārabhet ekāśīti vibhāgantu kathitaṃ tava śobhane ekenāvaraṇenaiva yajennityaṃ samāhitaḥ evaṃ * * * * ? yāgāḥ kathitā hyanupūrvaśaḥ pṛthivī tena sakalā sarāṣṭrā nāpasaṃyutā sa jñānī bhūtale nityaṃ sādhakaḥ sa śivaṃ nayet prayānti nātra sandeho jñānavicchinnabandhanāt catvāro hi mahāyāgāḥ akathyeyā varānane sthaṇḍile maṇḍale vā'pi vāyurākāśameva ca manasā cakṣuṣā caiva vacasā ca na saṃśayaḥ ebhyaḥ pravartate sarvaṃ asmin sarvamidaṃ smṛtam pūrvoktantu vidhiṃ kuryāt karṇikāyāṃ maheśvari pañcabrahmakalaiścaiva śivāṅgaiśca samanvitaḥ pañcabhiḥ brahmabhiścaiva vidhiṃ kuryādaśeṣataḥ

īśānaṃ madhyato dadyāt pūrvaṃ tatpuruṣaṃ nyaset sadyojātantu deveśi paścimena tu vinyaset naiṛtyāntu śikhāṃ devi vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ nyaset dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ devi kathyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu svanaṃ dakṣiṇato nyasya śabdaṃ naiṛtake nyaset uttareṇaiva jhaṅkāraṃ dhvaṅkṛtaṃtvīśagocare ukārādi smṛtā ye tu ghoṣādīnāñca vācakāḥ sakalaṃ pūrvavaktre tu āgneyyāṃ niṣkalaṃ nyaset khamalaṃ paścimenaiva kṣapaṇaṃ vāyugocare paramākṣarantu deveśi madhyadeśe tu vinyaset caturāvaraṇaṃ devi prakṛtyantaṃ tu vinyaset eṣa yāgaparaṃ devi kathitaṃ hyanupūrvaśaḥ siddhidaṃ muktidañcaiva nānena sadṛśaṃ bhavet śāntyatītantu hṛdayaṃ āgneyyāṃ parikalpayet eṣa sādāśivo yogaḥ kathitastava śobhane iḍikā dīpikā caiva recikā mocikā tathā ūrdhvagāmini deveśi nyasedāgneyagocare dīpikāntu mahābhāge vāyavyāṃ parikalpayet huṅkārantu śikhā proktā haiṃkāraṃ kavacaṃ bhavet garbhāvaraṇametaddhi kathitaṃ surasundari asya guhyataraṃ vakṣye śaktiyāgamanuttamam nānena kathitā martyā dīkṣānugrahakārakāḥ tasmācchreṣṭhopariṣṭhaśca nākhyena paridīkṣaṇe adhivāsanañcaivatri sarvaśeṣavivarjitam sarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ yanmahatsarvatomukham

nyāsamātreṇa mucyante sādhakājanmabandhanāt āsanaṃ kalpayenmantrī tatra nyāsantu kārayet pūjayitvā vidhānena devadevaṃ maheśvaram aghoraṃ dakṣiṇe caiva vāmadevaṃ tathottare āgneyyāṃ hṛdayañcaiva īśānyāntu śiro nyaset astraṃ diśāsu vinyasya makārādyāstu ye smṛtāḥ dakṣiṇe karṇikāpīṭhe vinyasecca navātmakaṃ śiraḥ śikhā ca kavacamastrañcaiva yathākramam paścime niyatiṃ dadyāt vāyavyāṃ kalavinyaset īśvaraṃ pūrvatatvaṃ āgneyyāṃ tu sadāśivam āgneyyāṃ hṛdayañcaiva īśānyāntu śironyaset uttare karṇikāyāntu praṇavaḥ parikalpayet vidyāśikhā samākhyātā pratiṣṭhāṃ kavacaṃ viduḥ ghoṣantu pūrvadigbhāge āgneyyāṃ ravameva ca paścimena smṛtaḥ sphoṭo dhvaniḥ vāyavyato nyaset pūrvataḥ karṇikāmadhye rudroṅkārantu vinyaset naiṛtyāntu śikhā proktā vāyavyāṃ kavacaṃ tathā śāntiṃ pūrvadiśābhāge vidyāṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset śāntyatītaṃ paraṃ tatvamastraṃ devasya kīrtitam amṛtācāgnidigbhāge kathitā tatvaśobhane eṣa yāgavaro devi nāmṛtaḥ kasyacinmayā evaṃ yaṣṭvā tu vidhinā dīkṣāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ pañcasvaśikhāṃ hutvā dīkṣānirvāṇagāminī prakriyāśūnyamantrāṇāṃ śāsanaṃ grahaṇaṃ tathā chedanaṃ kutra vā teṣāṃ śuddhatatvasya śaṅkara

tritatvaṃ paratatvañca tadeva kathayasva me yāni śreyastamānisyuḥ kathayasva prasādataḥ tadasmin sarvamasmākaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ guhyāt guhyataraṃ devi nākhyātaṃ kasyacinmayā anantamāditaḥ kṛtvā śivatatvamapaścimam adhastātparameśāno hyanantaḥ parameśvaraḥ yāmye śrotā tava proktā tasya te bhuvanā smṛtāḥ tasyopari samākhyātā narakā ghorarūpiṇaḥ anukrameṇa tān sarvān śodhayet parameśvari śodhanīyāstu deveśi krameṇa varavarṇinī kathitāstu samāsena ekaviṃśadanukramāt triguṇena sthitā devi pātālena samāsataḥ ekadhā caiva mānuṣyā jñeyaṃ saṃsāramaṇḍalam evaṃ saṃsāracakrantu kathitaṃ tava śobhane haviryajñāḥ pākayajñāḥ somasaṃkhyāstathaiva tu aṣṭādhikāśca jñātavyaṃ deśikena tu padaṃ prāpya parityajya antyeṣṭastadanantaram bhogasthāneṣu saṃyojya tasmādbhogādviyojayet bhūrloke tu tato yojya bhuvarlokaṃ tato nayet rudrāsane tato yojya saddhi daṇḍakrameṇa tu tena cāhutayassapta dadyācchudhyarthakāraṇāt evantu pṛthivī śuddhā śatarudrastu yojitā śatamekonaṣaṣṭiñca kathitaṃ tava śobhane prīṇayitvā kṛtān prājñaḥ tatve tatve yathākramam bhuvanāntarnivāsīnāṃ śikhenaivāhutiṃ hunet

pārthivāvaraṇaṃ devi anantādiranukramāt śatadvayaṃ samākhyātaṃ tathā caikona saptatiḥ pañcāṣṭakaṃ punaśśodhyaṃ pañcadhāvaraṇaiḥ kramāt krodhāṣṭakantu jñātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā tejoṣṭake tu saṃśuddhe śivadvādaśakaṃ punaḥ maṇḍalādhipatiñcaiva kathitaṃ tava śobhane guṇatrayaṃ buddhitatvaṃ śodhanīyaṃ yathākramam krodhatejoṣṭakaṃ śodhyaṃ yogibhiḥ sa śivaissaha gurupaṅktitrayaṃ devi gurorantaritāstathā etatpradhānamityuktaṃ bahuvistarataḥ sthitam tayo rūpāḥ samākhyātāḥ tatvānāntu purā mayā anantamāditaḥ kṛtvā pradhānāntastathāvadhi ataḥ paratarañcaiva puruṣaṃ kathayāmi te aṃbhādyāḥ śodhane tatra pauruṣe tu yathākramam dharmo daśavidhaḥ proktaḥ tava devi na saṃśayaḥ ahaṃkārastu trividho guṇatrayamudāhṛtam vigrahāṣṭakasaṃyuktā śodhanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ vyādhiśca śāśvato loke kṣuttṛṣṇāśokameva ca rāṇaśśokaśca mohaśca madamātsaryameva ca ete bandhātmakā pāśāḥ gaṇapāśīmato'nyathā deśapāśāstu ye tasya śivena parikīrtitāḥ śatapañcāśatenaiva pañcaviṃśena vā punaḥ ekāhutyā tu deveśi śodhanīyāḥ śivādhvare dhyātvā bhaktimayaṃ śiṣyaṃ dīkṣāṃ kuryāttu deśikaḥ śatamekantu vikhyātā niyatyāṃ bhuvanādhipāḥ

śuklakṛṣṇavibhāgasthāṃ dhyātvā śodhyeta mokṣakaḥ kālatatve tu vikhyātā koṭyanekaparigrahāḥ suhṛṣṭaḥ suprahṛṣṭaśca surūpo rūpavardhaniḥ ataḥ paratareṇaiva vidyeśānāḥ prakīrtitāḥ vidyātatve tu jñātavyāḥ deśikena mahātmanā vidhinā śodhanīyāstu deśikena mahātmanā gopateśca tadordhvantu grathidvāre vyavasthitāḥ ataḥ paratareṇaiva trikālaḥ kṣemīśa eva ca yogakṣemapradātārā dīkṣādhvānaviśodhitāḥ madamohasamāyuktaṃ evamādimahāśaye chaṅkārasādhyamoṅkāra dātāradavaneśikam pramāṇāṣṭakamevāpi māyāvaraṇasaṃsthitaḥ evamādīni hutvā tu munetmanāṃ vidhānavit ebhyo madhye tu ye rudrāḥ kathayāmyanupūrvaśaḥ rage'pi ca daśa proktāḥ vidyāyāṃ na punardaśa upariṣṭātpunaḥ pañcamāyātatvā tu saṃsthitāḥ madamohādi saṃyuktāḥ pāśahastā mahābalāḥ saṃkhyā vai bhuvanānāntu saptatiḥ saptacādhikāḥ anantamāditaḥ kṛtvā māyātatvamapaścimam ekasaṃśīkṛtāssarve kathayāmi tavākhilam bhuvanā saptacādhikyaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane ātmatatvamidaṃ khyātaṃ māyāntaṃ surasundari ananteśāditaḥ kṛtvā hotavyamanupūrvaśaḥ īśvare śodhanīyāstu māyāñjanavivarjitāḥ vāmājjyeṣṭhādayastasmāt śaktayaḥ parikīrtitāḥ

tāṃ viditvā mahādevi deśikaḥ pāśahā bhavet dvau rudrau tu samākhyātau yogamokṣaphalapradau catvārastu smṛtā rudrāḥ yogamokṣa phalapradāḥ atopari dhruvaṃ devi rudraikādaśakaṃ punaḥ teṣāṃ tu parato devi dhruvaścaiva tṛtīyakaḥ ato nirañjanaṃ proktaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate ataścaivopariṣṭāttu aṣṭau te bhuvaneśvarāḥ śodhanīyā varārohe yogakṣemapradāyakāḥ ataḥ paraṃ nirālaṃbaṃ sarvadhyāna vivarjitam nāparaṃ na parañcaiva parāparavivarjitam pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthañca nirmalaṃ paramaṃ padam tena sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ kalpanātītalakṣaṇam otaprotamanādyantaṃ sarvatatvāvabhāsakam etatte kathitaṃ devi bhuvanānāṃ samāsataḥ vidyātatve tu deveśi bhuvaneśāḥ prakīrtitāḥ tān pravakṣyāhaṃ devi guṇatatvena suvrate viditvā śodhane devi deśikaḥ tatvapāragaḥ ekasaṃkhyaikataḥ kṛtvā pravakṣyāmi varānane viṃśadvayañca jñātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā pūrṇāhutyā śatenāpi viśuddhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ praśāntena trayaḥ proktāḥ sarvādhvānamaśeṣataḥ praṇavena samākhyātaṃ śāntyatītena vā punaḥ kālādhvanaṃ varārohe bhuvanādhvena homayet kalādhvāne tathaiveha kathitaṃ tava śobhane veditavyaṃ prayatnena deśikena mahātmanā

upapannāya dāntāya gurudevaratāya ca pūjayitvā vidhānena devadevaṃ maheśvaram savyahaste tu yaṣṭavyaṃ vāmahastena saṃvrate gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ yathā nyāyaṃ pūjayitvā vidhānavit ātmanyevaṃ vaśīkṛtya śiṣyasya parameśvari tatvāni dehato'nyasya sthānantu śirasi nyaset dhyātvā devaṃ maheśānaṃ bhūmimadhye tu tatvavit evaṃ kṛte tato devi śivahasteti sa smṛtaḥ anena vidhinā devi kuryāttasyāpyanugraham bhūtapretapiśācebhyo rākṣasebhyassamādhipe adhvānaṃ kurute sohi na tu na vyāpayetparam putrako yena deveśi kathyate śivayogibhiḥ gaṇayāgāditaḥ kṛtvā dṛṣṭvā khermaṇḍalāni tu yojitastu pare tatve putrakassa vidhīyate mantrakalpasuvettā ca deśakālavidhānavit tāpane dīpane caiva chedane ca tathaiva ca paramantravibhedajño mantrāpyāyanatatparaḥ pātane daityabhūtebhyaḥ siṃhavidyādhareṣvapi samarthaśca parityāgī japāsaktassadā mataḥ utsāhavān sadā dakṣaḥ sādhakassa vidhīyate abhiṣekapradātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā abhiṣiñcettataḥ śiṣyaṃ vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā saṃpuṭīkṛtya paścāttu vidyākhyenābhiṣecayet pṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā nirvāṇāntena śobhane maṇḍalasyeśabhāge tu kuryādvai caturaṅgakam

toraṇaissapatākaiśca diśāsu vidiśāsu ca akālamūlakalaśaiścandanenopalepitaiḥ sarvoṣadhi samāyuktaiḥ ekaikaṃ kalaśaṃ kuru ekaikakalaśe devi vinyaseta yathākramam pṛthivyādīni kalaśe vinyaseta yathākramam vedaśabdajayākāraiḥ pūrvādārabhya śobhane nirvāṇakalaśaṃ yāvat eṣa eva vidhismṛtaḥ arghyādibhissamabhyarcya adhikāraṃ samarpayet kartavyo'nugrahaṃ nityaṃ caturāśramasaṃyutam svalpamahni japaṃ kāryaṃ svalpamanhau tu homayet ete'dhikārā ye proktāḥ śivajñāne vikalpitāḥ evaṃ kurvāmahe tāta yattvayā kathitaṃ mama evaṃ tvaṃ pūjayitvā tu ācāryaḥ sumahāmatiḥ visarjite tato devi gurupūjāmupakramet tatrasthaṃ sthāpya pūjyeta yathāvidhi purassaram yathā bhagavataḥ pūjāṃ kuryādācāryakasya tu śivavatpūjayeddevi ācāryaṃ tantrapāragam tatprasādādbhavetsiddhiḥ muktiścaiva śivoditā karṇikākaṭakairvastraiḥ mekhalairmakuṭaistathā hastyaśvarathayānaiśca rukmabhedaiśca saṃyutam yena yena sutuṣṭena na tattat dadyāttu putrakaḥ nivedite tato devi anṛṇo jāyate guroḥ bhojayedgurubhaktāṃśca dīnānāthāṃśca tarpayet vaktavyantu tato devi prīyatāṃ bhagavāñcchivaḥ anyathā kurute yastu ācāryaṃ pratisādhakaḥ

ācāryaṃ śivavanmantā vidyāccaiśvarasādhakam mānyāḥ pūjyāśca deveśi anyonyaprītitāṃ vrajet tatvenāpi vidhijñena dīkṣitaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet na tasya hanyate siddhiḥ yāvaddevaḥ sadāśivaḥ ācāryasya tu deveśe samayī putrakasya ca sarvathā sarvamāno'pi tatvavinmocayetpaśum mānuṣīṃ tanumāsādya śive jñātaṃ prayacchati māyā tasya na kartavyā kṛtvā māyāṃ vrajatyayam pratyekaṃ saṃsmṛtā mantrāḥ mayā proktāstu suvrate pañcabrahmaśivāṅgaiśca vidyāṅgāni tathaiva ca śāntyatītañca praṇavaṃ tathā caiva navātmakam yatra pratyekahomasyāt tatra sādhāraṇairyajet praṇave kathitā ye tu te tu pratyekaśasmṛtāḥ padabhedavibhāgena aṣṭatriṃśatkalaistathā śodhyaśodhakabhāvena tathā cānye prakīrtitāḥ daśayā dīpitairmantraiḥ karmakuryādyathepsitam huṅkāramādiyogena svāhāntena tu mantriṇam oṅkāramāditaḥ kṛtvā vauṣaḍantena mantriṇaḥ oṅkāradīpitā mantrā namaskārāntayojitāḥ suvauṣaṭkārasaṃyuktaṃ puṣyarthe viniyojayet manonmaneti mantrāṇāṃ indyanārthaṃ prayojayet māraṇe phaṭ phaḍityeva mantraṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ phaṭkāramantrayogena pāśacchedakarasmṛtim aviditvā na sidhyeta na ca yāti paraṃ padam sidhyante sādhakendrāstu prayogairmantrayojitaiḥ

dīkṣā homaṃ sadā kuryāt svāhākārāntikaṃ padam vauṣaḍantena deveśi pūrṇāhutyāntu dāpayet pañcaṣaṭ saptacāṣṭau tu bahvakṣaramayaḥ paraḥ āpādatalamūrdhāntaṃ vyāpayitvā vyavasthitaḥ caturviṃśatibhistatvaiḥ prakṛtibhiḥ parikīrtitaḥ bhuvanārthaṃ caturviṃśat vyākhyātāni śivena tu kathitaṃ viṣṇudaivatyaṃ hṛdayāt karṇikāvadhi viṣṇunā saha modante viṣṇutulyaparākramāḥ vidyāvidyeśvaraiścaiva tatra te bhuvanaissaha krīḍate rudraloke tu rudratulyabalo bhuvi sa tatra īśvaro devaḥ ādhipatyena saṃsthitaḥ tatra devaḥ sadākhyastu ādhipatyena saṃsthitaḥ sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgena viditvā mokṣamāpnuyāt iḍikādīpikā caiva rocikā mocikā tathā kalāhyetāstu catvāraḥ ekatve tu yadā sthitāḥ sūkṣmamekavidhañcaiva ūrdhvagāmīti viśrutam vyāptiyogena jñātavyā devatāhyaghanāśanāḥ sūkṣmā caiva susūkṣmā ca amṛtā ca mṛtāmṛtā tasyāpi parataḥ sūkṣmā vyāpinītyabhidhīyate taṃ viditvā vimucyante narāssaṃsārasāgarāt tasmin śūnyalayaṃ devi vighnantīṃ vinirdiśet kaṇṭhastho viramecchabdaḥ ardhacandra iti smṛtaḥ nirodhī sā vinirdiṣṭā lalāṭe tu layaṃ viduḥ abhinno ghāṭamityuktaṃ lalāṭe tu layaṃ viduḥ abhinno ghāṭamityuktaṃ lalāṭastho nivartate

nādatatvalaye līnā sa paratvena gacchati tasmādgurutaro devi gurupāraṃparāgataḥ japayogavinirmuktaṃ karaṇādhāravarjitam kliśyante devatāssarve ṛṣayaḥ sāṃśatavratāḥ etatsarvaṃ paratvena kathitaṃ tatvamuttamam mantramuccārato devi yāvannānyamano bhavet namaskāraṃ tataḥ proktaṃ svāhākārāntayojitam prāṇe tu taccaturthī tu vibhedavaravarṇinī uttarāyaṇapūrvāhṇe dvitīye dakṣiṇāyanam catvāro viṣuvā devi jānīte deśikottamaḥ etatsarvaṃ samāsena mayā tu kathitaṃ tava mantraṃ samaraso devi śivena parikīrtitaḥ nāḍīsamaraso devi kathitastava śobhane sa bhūtasamaraso devi mayā te parikīrtitaḥ tatvaṃ samāsato devi śivena kathitaṃ mama na mayā kasyacitkhyātaṃ tatvaṃ samarasaṃ śubham tatvasandhānadeveśi tatvataḥ kathayāmi te śivādi tarpaṇaṃ kṛtvā anupūrveṇa mantravit nāticitramapāyasya sūtracchedaṃ tathaiva ca etān hutvā tato mantrī mantrāṇāṃ dīpanaṃ hunet huṅkāramādimadhyeṣu ante caiva prayojayet evaṃ sandīpanaṃ kṛtvā paśorathe varānane śivatatve tu vidyākhyāmātmatatvañca vidyayā tatastu śivatatvena sandhayīta vicakṣaṇaḥ vidyeśāṃ śivatatvena lokeśān vidyasaṃjñite

evantu sandhānaṃ kṛtvā pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayet sa dhūmaściṭaciṭāśabdo viṣṇuliṅgairvirājitaḥ nīlamamranibhākāraṃ sa dhūmaṃ śālikā mataḥ vistaraṃ ghorarūpañca sa dhūmañca likhenmahīm sarveṣāṃ rūpamādhatte kṛṣyamāno'pi pāvakaḥ upapātakināścānye tānyevamupalakṣayet uṣṭragṛdhrasvarāghorāḥ śivāvānararāvakāḥ jalate kradhukā śabdaḥ phaṭkāraśca sakṛt sakṛt dṛṣṭvaitānyapacihnāni dīkṣākarma na kārayet homayeddīpanañcaiva navatatvālayaṃ prabhuḥ paścāttatvakṛtaṃ tatvaṃ punarhomakṛtena tu yathā viṣaṃ mahāghoraṃ saptadhātugataṃ haret brahmahatyādipāpāni upapātakināṃ tathā evaṃ saṃśodhya śiṣyantu dīkṣākarma samārabhet kathayā doṣamāyāti tasmātkruddhaṃ vivarjayet prakriyāsūtrayogañca pāśānāṃ grahaṇaṃ tathā kanyā kartṛtvasūtreṇa triguṇītriguṇī kṛte arcyekādaśakenaiva tatsūtrantu vicakṣaṇaḥ pādāṅguṣṭhapradeśe tu sūtraṃ kṛtvā pradhārayet sakalīkṛtya tatsūtraṃ sarvamantrairvicakṣaṇaḥ tena pāśāni saṃgṛhya sūtragranthyā tu kārayet tatvena bandhayedbhūyaḥ tān pāśāṃstu vicakṣaṇaḥ badhvā pāśaṃ yathānyāyaṃ vāsayeddeva saṃyutam dīpayeta tataḥ pāśāṃ huṃphaḍantaḥ krameṇa tu prabhāte vimale mantrī pradīptehani suvṛte

homānte tu tato mantrī pāśacchedantu kārayet hutvā pāśāṃ tato mantrī pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayet tatsthānāttataḥ pāśān tatvaṃ tatvena sandhayet vilīnamānaṃ saṃcintya sandhītakaraṇānvitam pṛthivīmāditaḥ kṛtvā śivatatvamapaścimam tatvānāṃ sandhanañcaiva eṣa eva vidhismṛtaḥ varṇādhve ca padādhve ca mantrādhve ca tathaiva hi bhuvanādhve tataḥ kuryāt kathayāmi samāsataḥ gandhairdhūpaiḥ samabhyarcya tato yonivikalpanam śikhayā tāḍanaṃ kṛtvā grāhyasaṃhāramudrayā dvādaśāntamanuprāptaṃ tato grāhyaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ adhikāre daśā dadyāt bhoge dadyāddaśāhutiḥ viyojya mantravit prājñaḥ pāśacchedantu kārayet pūrṇāhutiṃ tatonte tu raudraṃ tasmāttu uddharet vidhimevaṃ sakṛt jñātvā mocayennātra saṃśayaḥ tatvamāvāhayeddevi tato homaṃ prakalpayet śivena yojayettatra hunettenaiva suvṛte tritatvādhvaraśuddhe ca śikhācchedantu kārayet yojite tu pare tatve staumyamāhutayo hunet paritṛpto bhavasveti nirvāṇaṃ bhavasveti ca sarvavyāpīti hotavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā yaduktaṃ devadevena tadbhavennātra saṃśayaḥ varṇādhvāne tathā proktaṃ kartavyaṃ deśikena tu praṇave yojanañcaiva tāḍane praṇavasmṛtaḥ varṇādhvāne yathā proktaṃ padādhvāne tathaiva ca

mantrādhvānaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepānna tu vistarāt sāvitryā tāḍanaṃ kuryāt grāhyaṃ tenaiva mantrataḥ utkarṣaṇantu tenaiva sāvitryā tu vicakṣaṇaḥ pūrṇāhutiḥ pradātavyā yojanāya pare śive eṣa eva vidhirdevi kathito hyanupūrvaśaḥ sarvasaṃhitasāmānyaṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi sādhakānāṃ hitāvaham anantadharmajñānañca vairāgyaiśvaryameva ca padmañca candanaṃ tena karṇikāntena kārayet devatāntena kartavyā mūrtyantenaiva kārayet āvāhanantu tenaiva kartavyaṃ surasundari nivṛttistu śirastasya iḍikāhṛdayaṃ viduḥ pṛthivī tu bhavedastraṃ brahmaṇāṅgāḥ prakīrtitāḥ paścimenottareṇaiva madhye praṇavasaṃyutam śikhā naiṛtadigbhāge kavacaṃ vāyugocare ikārastu śikhā devi akārastu śirasmṛtam lakāramastramityuktaṃ grāhakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ bhūtatvaṃ brahmatatvasya praṇavena tu homayet yojane sādhakendrāya prajanatvamapāśrite brahmaṇe tu yathā proktaṃ viṣṇave'pi tathā smṛtam rukāro hṛdayaṃ proktamīkārastu śikhā smṛtā pūrvoktena vidhānena kuryādāvāhanaṃ budhaḥ anādye tu pade devi viṣṇusāyujyatāṃ vrajet vidyāśirassamākhyātamaṅgāraṃ nāma nāmataḥ aghoraṃ kavacaṃ devi rudratatvasya śobhane

āsane'yaṃ vidhirdevi mayā te parikīrtitāḥ vidyāśirassamākhyātaṃ makāraṃ nāma nāmataḥ yakāramastramityuktamaṅgānyetāni ceśvari anantā rudratatvasya nirvāṇaṃ paramaṃ padam nidhanena tu kartavyaṃ tatvena tu sadāśive paramākṣaraṃ śikhā tasya śāntyatītaṃ śirasmṛtam śūnyatatvaṃ hakārastu astraṃ tatparikīrtitam ete pañcamahāyāgā nākhyātā kasyacinmayā teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya mayā tu kathitaṃ tava naiṣṭhikānāntu kartavyaṃ liṅgoddhāraṃ samīritam athavā brahmavidye tu abhiyuktastu sādhakaḥ vaiṣṇave'pi tathaiveha kathitaṃ parameṣṭhinā gaṇaguhyakamantreṣu sādhanenaiva sādhakaḥ ḍākinyo mātaraścaiva yoginyo'pi tathā parāḥ īśvare pāśupatyānāṃ uddhāre tu vicakṣaṇaḥ śuddhāyuktastu etasmin dīkṣitena muktimicchatā yajeddevādideveśaṃ sarveṣāṃ phalamāpnuyāt eṣa te yoga ākhyātaḥ pañcavyomātmakaśśubhaḥ caturāvaraṇairyāgaṃ kartavyaṃ deśikena tu dvitīyāvaraṇe devi kalā śaktyātmakāni tu nādasyekakalā yāstu diśāsu vidiśāsu ca eṣa te yāga ākhyāto durlabhastridaśairapi eṣa sarvādayo yāgāḥ kathitāstava śobhane praṇavaṃ hyāsanaṃ kṛtvā mātṛkāṃ tu yajedbudhaḥ dakṣiṇe yojayedbījaṃ vāme yonintu vinyaset

avargaṃ pūrvapatre tu kavargañcāgnigocare tavargaṃ paścime caiva pavargaṃ vāyugocare eṣa vai mātṛkāyāgaḥ kathitaṃ tava śobhane evaṃ vargakrameṇaiva śivatatvantu mātṛkān rudroṅkāreṇa deveśi vidyātatvantu kārayet evante mātṛkāyāgo durlabhastridaśairapi kathaṃ tasmin pradeśe ca śiṣyāssthāpyā maheśvara kṣatriyāṇāntu yatsthānaṃ vaiśyānāṃ vada śaṅkara grahamedhi yathā kāryo dīkṣākāle maheśvara śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi niyogavidhimuttamam īśānyāṃ yatayasthāpyā viprāścottarataḥ sthitāḥ vaiśyāḥ paścimadigbhāge śūdrā vai naiṛtena tu evaṃ saṃsthāpya vidhivat kuryādālabhanakriyām tasya saṃskārayogo'yamatiruddhā samācaret gṛhasthaṃ śivavadbhāvaṃ tadbhāryāmagnikātanau dikpālaiḥ kulajān gṛhyāt śeṣānastragaṇānyaset sadārāpatyapatyānāṃ niyogaḥ parikīrtitaḥ atraiva viniyuktasya striyāyānantu kārayet mahādoṣamavāpnoti caryāyuḥ paripālyate gurutalpasamaṃ pāpaṃ hṛṣṭasaṃskārapāpakṛt puṣpalātacitānasya kriyayoḥ paripūraṇam anena vidhinā devi doṣahīno bhavedguruḥ grahiṇāntu vidhāno'yaṃ kathitastava śobhane homaḥ kāryastu deveśi ācāryeṇa mahātmanā śivamantrasya samayī mantratantrottaro bhavet

tritatvaviniviṣṭastu mokṣayogyaḥ prajāyate pratyayāni yathā samyak aṇimādiguṇāṣṭakam viśokaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā mṛtī bhavet sa dīkṣāṃ kartumarheta anyathā pāpakṛt bhavet agnisthānamupakramya karma nirvartayedguruḥ siddhāsiddhavibhāgajño varṇarūpahutāśane tasya mantrāḥ parā mūrtiḥ ādyaṃ vai somasaṃbhavam saptajihvāvidhānajño homakarma samārabhet yathā dāharate karma tatsarvaṃ saphalaṃ bhavet tuṣyate yajamānasya santuṣṭho vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ekībhūtāstu tiṣṭhanti svalahavyendhanena tu jvālāmālāsahasraistu pātālaṃ vadanaṃ smṛtam devatārūpakañcaiva phalaṃ tasyaiva yādṛśam homakāle prayatnena dve jihve parivarjayet dvitīyā yakṣadaivatyā tāmrākārasamaprabhā pañcamī viṣṇudevatyā atasīpuṣpasannibhā saptamī bahudevatyā sarvarūpaistu dīpyate tṛtīyā praṇayetsarvāṃ jananaṃ sthāpya saṅgamān ṣaṣṭhī tu sūryadevatyā ārogyaṃ sā prayacchati tasmātsarvaprayatnena madhye homaṃ praśasyate tasmātsarvaprayatnena dve jihve parivarjayet ādityodayavarṇābhā snigdhavaiḍūryasannibhā taptāyasasavarṇābhā kusaṃbharasasannibhāḥ indrāyudhasavarṇābhā indugopakasannibhāḥ vidhūme lelihāne ca hotavyaṃ karmasiddhaye

snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇāvartassarvakarmaphalapradaḥ saṃskārayogaḥ kartavyo yathāvattannibodhaye uccārya navatatvāni akāreṇa tu bheditān jaṅghe gulphe tathā pāde sarvatra viniyojayet navātmanāhutiśataṃ svāhākāreṇa pātayet sānnidhyabandhanārthantu evaṃ bhavati śobhane yojitavyaṃ śive paścāt putrako deśikena tu garbhādhānāditaḥ kṛtvā catvāriṃśāṣṭakaṃ kramāt nikṣepoddhārayogādīn saṃskārāṃśca yathākramam nakārasaṃpuṭaṃ devi pakārokārayojitaḥ śivena saha deveśi nātrakāryā vicāraṇā eṣa sarvavidhānantu śreṣṭhasarvaguṇottamam nissaṃśayakarañcaiva nirvāṇaphalasādhanam tena vijñātamātreṇa prāpnoti paramaṃ padam ṣakāraṃ śatarudre tu daśadhā parikalpayet yogāṣṭake yakārastu suśiveraṃ prabhusmṛtaḥ bhakārassaṃhitassādhye bakāraśśivasaṅkare daśaghāte nakārastu pañcaśiṣye ca ya smṛtaḥ śivabrahmapade tantu ṇakāro nandahemake vāgeśānte ṭhakārastu ṭakāraḥ pratipādhipaḥ dhyānāhāre jhakāro vai vijñeyaṃ sādhakottamaiḥ dhātāro vai dakāraśca ghakāraṃ bhasmamīśvare kakāro mūrtiraṣṭāsu oṣṭhānto rūpakaṃ viduḥ oṅkāropyastramityuktamaiṅkāraṃ kavacaṃ viduḥ hṛdayantu ḷ vijñeyaṃ ṛ sāvitrī nigadyate

āsane u iti jñeyaṃ vijñeyaṃ ī ti karṇikā sadāśivaṃ vijānīyādakāraḥ paramaśśivaḥ sa jñānāt sa śivassākṣāt sa yogī sa śivaṃ viduḥ viṃśaviṃśatibhiścaiva pañcaviṃśatibhistathā dīkṣākāryā tu mantrajñaḥ paśūnāñca yathecchayā praśāntena dvayaṃ dadyāt tattu ekāhutiṃ hunet etadrahasyaṃ paramaṃ gopitaṃ na prakāśitam gurupriyāya dātavyaṃ śivabhaktiratāya ca anyathā naiva dātavyaṃ dīkṣājñānamidaṃ śubham viditvā jñānavijñānaṃ mocayenmucyateti ca varṇamantrapadenaiva kalayā ca caturvidham jñānādhvā ca padādhvā ca varṇādhvā ca yathā punaḥ eṣāmekadaśaṃ śodhyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā vasordhāraprayogena dātavyaṃ deśikena tu tasmānmantrañca tatvañca mahimānañca śobhane bindunādalayañcaiva layātītaṃ paraṃ padam ataḥ saṃkṣepato devi kathayāmi tavākhilam yatra yatra pradeśe tu pūjayitvā maheśvaram bhuvanādhvā tu yaḥ prokto mayā tu tava suvṛte homayettantravitprājñaḥ tatvamārgavicakṣaṇaḥ sahasreṇa tu yudhyeta amanaskena śobhane sruvānupūraṇaṃ yāvattāvatkālaṃ samādiśet sarvamantramayaḥ proktaḥ sarvatatvamayastathā etaṃ hutvā tu pātavyaṃ pūrṇāhutyā tu śobhane evaṃ hutvā mahādevi labhate śāśvataṃ śivam

anyāyā kathitā dīkṣā ekāhutyā tu śudhyati kiṃ punarbahudhā hutyā śudhyateti kimadbhutam ata evaṃ punarvakṣye saṃkṣepaṃ śṛṇu suvrate pūrṇāhutiśatenaiva śudhyate ca śivādhvare niṣkalena mayā khyātaṃ śūnyenaiva tathā punaḥ akathyeyamidaṃ śuddhaṃ gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ na cāsau deśikaḥ prokto na ca yojyaḥ śivādhvare yasmin pratiṣṭhitaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sa carācaram sa jñeyassakalo devo varṇarūpadharaḥ prabhuḥ pītasvacchakapotañca śabalaṃ karburaṃ tathā sarvāyudhadharaṃ śaṃbhuṃ jaṭābhāravibhūṣitam sarvasiddhikaraṃ devaṃ sādhakānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ gulikākāśagamane dantakāṣṭhaparitrake sarvaṃ saṃpadyate samyak japataḥ sakalaṃ priye pūjayetsakalaṃ devaṃ japetsakalaniṣkalam pūjayecchakalaṃ devaṃ śiraḥ pāṇyādibhiryutam japakāle sadā devaṃ kuryācchakalaniṣkalam dhyāyejjyotirmayaṃ sūkṣmaṃ raktaṃ pītaṃ sitāsitam tarpaṇe sarvamantrāṇāṃ svāhākārasamanvitam huṃkāraḥ phaṭkṛtaścaiva dvirabhyastaṃ bhavediva svāhākāre yadābhinno pratiṣṭhā nāma sā kalā vidyābindusamāyuktā śāntistu sa visargataḥ sādhakānāṃ hitārthāya śivena kathitaṃ purā uccāṭane ca vidveṣastaṃbhane ca prayojayet pañcatatvamayaṃ devaṃ sarvatatvamayaṃ tathā

yasmin yasmiṃśca deveśi jñāyate su parisphuṭam saptatatvaparaṃ devi tatvamekādaśa prabhum ṣaṭtriṃśātmā tu vijñeyaṃ kalātatvaṃ sa eva tu mantrātmā tu sa vijñeyo bhuvanādhvā sa eva tu ṣaṭtriṃśakassavijñeyaḥ īśvaraḥ parameśvaraḥ pañcarātraṃ tu tatvajñaiḥ sa eva parikīrtitaḥ bauddhaścārhatāścaiva nyāyavaiśeṣikāstathā sa eva kathito haṃsaḥ sakalaḥ parameśvari śaktinādārdhacandraśca bindudevastathaiva ca eṣa dehe samākhyātaḥ sakalasya vinirṇayaḥ kathayeddevadevasya tannibodha samāsataḥ ukārastu tṛtīyastu makārastu caturthakam ebhirvaṇairyadā hīnaṃ niṣkalaṃ parameśvaram ta ete saṃsthitaikastho hukāraḥ parikīrtitaḥ yadā bindugato śaṃbhuḥ nāsikāyāṃ pravartate nābhivarṇairyadā hīnaṃ tadā śūnyaṃ vinirdiśet akāraḥ kathito devi bindunādapare sthitaḥ śaktyātītaṃ yadā devi kiñciccheṣamavasthitam sakalānugraheṇaiva kathitaṃ tava śobhane eṣa devi samākhyāto dehe yasmātpratiṣṭhitā dehayuktastu deveśe sakalaḥ paripaṭhyate īkārasahasaṃyuktaṃ dehaṃ tasya varānane kathitaṃ pūrvasūtre tu tattvayā viditaṃ purā niṣkalassa samākhyāto veditavyaḥ suśobhane ātmajñānena saṃyukto gacchate sa sadāśive

vyāpinyā tu yadāyuktaṃ ṣaḍvarṇarahitaśśivaḥ asaṃkhyānañca sūryāṇāṃ uditoditasuprabham tatsthāne tu yadāhyātmā tadrūpaḥ pratibhāti saḥ tasyāṃ madhye tadāhyātmā tadrūpaḥ pratibhāti saḥ tasmiṃsthāne tadāhyātmā tadrūpapratimo bhavet candrātapapratīkāśā amṛtaṃ sravate sadā tatsthāne tu tadāhyātmā tadrūpaḥ pratibhāti saḥ ebhirvarṇairyadāhīnaṃ ṣaḍvarṇarahitaśśivaḥ ṣaṭpadārthamidaṃ jñānaṃ kathitaṃ parameṣṭhinā yena yena ca te tattat bhāvābhāvamavāpnuyāt yadyadrūpeṇa saṃyujyet tadrūpaṃ pratibhāti ca tasmātkaraṇasaṃyukto badhyate mucyateti ca jñānena tallayaṃ jñeyaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvagato bhavet jñātvā hyātmā vinirdiṣṭo jñānajñeyaṃ sa jānate evante jñānamākhyātaṃ ṣaḍvarṇaṃ parameśvari na tasya śakyate vaktuṃ pāraṃparyeṇa saṃsthitam jñānavijñānavān so hi mocakassa gurussadā brahmādayasmṛtāste tu ye rūpāḥ kathitā mayā etaddevi mayā khyātaṃ tatvaṃ paramadurlabham sakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva tathā sakalaniṣkalam bindudevaṃ paraṃ tatvaṃ jñeyaṃ sakalaniṣkalam ātmatatve trayo devā vidyātatve tathaiva ca śaktistu paramā devi tritatvaparamā sthitā tasmāt sarvamidaṃ devi tato sarvamidaṃ tatam vyāptirbahuvidhā proktā samayā nāvadhāritā

sarvatatvamayañcaiva sarvabhūtamayaṃ katham ṣoḍaśāvayavātmānaṃ ekaviṃśātmakaṃ katham mātṛkātmeti yatproktaṃ ekāśīti padātmakam pañcaviṃśasavijñeyaḥ ṣaḍviṃśakastathaiva ca pāñcarātrikatatvajñaḥ sa eva paramaṃ padam sarveṣu saṃsthitaṃ devaṃ sakalaḥ parameśvaraḥ itihāsapurāṇajñā dharmaśāstraratāśca ye sevante devadeveśaṃ sakalaṃ parameśvaram sarvametadaśeṣantu vistareṇa bravīhi me śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sakalasya vinirṇayam pañcadevamayaṃ devi brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ pañcadevā smṛtā hyete sarvataḥ paryavasthitāḥ ūkāraṃ viṣṇudevatyaṃ bindudevaṃ tatheśvaram sakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva kalāḍhyaṃ śūnyameva ca ete bhūtāssamākhyātāḥ karaṇaiḥ sahasaṃyutāḥ guṇatrayaṃ tathā devi bhūtātmakamidaṃ smṛtam bhūtaiḥ parivṛtā yasmin karaṇāśeṣaśobhane vidyāceśvaramāyā ca kālo niyatireva ca īśvarastu śiraścaiva vidyādakṣiṇarekhiṇī niyatiḥ kālo'dhastāttu boddhavyamanupūrvaśaḥ saptatatvadharaṃ devameṣa te samudāhṛtam śṛṇuṣvāvahitā devi kathayāmi tavākhilam upariṣṭācchivaṃ tatva mūrdhvaśaktipratiṣṭhitam ṣoḍaśāvayavātmānaṃ yaduktaṃ hi mayā purā tṛṭirlavaṃ nimeṣastu kalākāṣṭhā muhūrtatā

yugaṃ manvantaraṃ kalpaṃ mahākalpastathaiva ca ṣaṭtriṃśātmeti yatproktaṃ śṛṇu tasya vadāmyaham caturviṃśati tatvaṃ hi puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam aṣṭāviṃśa smṛtaṃ rāgaṃ vidyā jñeyā tathā parā triṃśatastu kalātatvaṃ kathitaṃ hi śivena tu dvātriṃśakasmṛtā vidyā trayastriṃśādhikeśvaram śivaṣṣaṭtriṃśamākhyātā śivena paramātmanā kalā caturthī sā jñeyā deśikena mahātmanā sadyā kalābhiraṣṭābhiḥ vāmadevastrayodaśam īśānaṃ pañcadhā devi tasya dehādvinissṛtāḥ bindudeve ca catvāraḥ kalā devi vadāmyaham kalāhyetāstu catvāraḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ sūkṣmāsūkṣmatarairbhāvaiḥ sakalaḥ parameśvaraḥ mātṛkātmeti yatproktaṃ mayā te surasundari sa kāmasya tu deveśi deho jñeyāssadā budhaiḥ ekāśīti padātme tu yaduktaṃ parameśvari mantrātmā tu kriyā proktaḥ sa eva parameśvaraḥ tābhyo bindudvayamante tābhyāṃ te alikadvayam dvitīyā bindvadhastāttu mantrātmā sa tu kīrtitaḥ tena sarvamidaṃ devi trailokyaṃ sa carācaram tiryaṅmṛganarākhyānāṃ sa jīvaḥ parikīrtitaḥ sarveṣāmeva mantrāṇāṃ kathitaṃ tava śobhane saṃjñeyassarvamantreṣu sarvatantreṣu śobhane eṣa te jñānasadbhāvaṃ mantrasadbhāva eva ca gopitavyaṃ prayatnena jñānametatsudurlabham

naiva mantrāḥ prasidhyanti japtāḥ koṭiśatairapi subhāṣitamidaṃ vākyaṃ kalānārhanti ṣoḍaśī sarvasvaṃ gopitaṃ jñātaṃ na khyātaṃ yasya kasyacit sarvatantravidhijñāya sādhakāya ca dhīmate anyāyai gṛhyate ye tu nābhinandanti ye gurum tasmāt jñānaṃ guruñcaiva a * * * * *? vṛte vibhaktiñcaiva kurvīta parameśena bhāṣitam viditvā sarvakarmāṇi kuru devi yathecchayā nātaḥ parataraṃ jñānaṃ satyaṃ devi vadāmyaham tatpravakṣyāmyahaṃ devi saṃkṣepānna tu vistarāt te mayā pūrvamākhyātaṃ yathā tu viditaṃ tvayā brahmā tatrādhipatyena saṃsthitaṃ parameśvari viṣṇustatvādhipatyena saṃsthitaṃ parameśvari rudrastatvādhipatyena saṃsthitaḥ parameśvaraḥ īśvara ādhipatyena saṃsthito nātra saṃśayaḥ vyāpinaṃ pañcadhā devi bhuvanādhvamaśeṣataḥ tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tadekāgramanā śṛṇu pṛthivyāpastathā tejo vāyurākāśameva ca tanmātrāṇi tathā pañca katitaṃ tava śobhane caturviṃśat smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ kṣetrajñaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ vyaktāvyaktavijñānāt jñātvā kucyati bandhanāt jñasvabhāvo bhavedātmā puruṣaṃ pañcaviṃśakam niṣkriyaṃ tatsvabhāvena akartā karmaṇaḥ prabhuḥ evaṃ vadanti deveśi ṣaṣṭitantrādhvavādinaḥ viṣayendriyatanmātraiḥ guṇādividhivācakaiḥ

bhoktā tu puruṣaḥ proktaḥ cinmātro guṇavarjitaḥ niṣkalatvena manyante sarvajñaṃ sarvatomukham ityetatpauruṣaṃ tatvaṃ sāṃkhyānāṃ paramaṃ padam yairbaddhaḥ paśutānaiti ajñatvañca prajāyate arthitvaṃ pāratantrañca dharmāṣṣaṭ pauruṣāstvime niṣkrayatvādudāsīno akartā ajñatā punaḥ dharmāhyete smṛtāstasya mātṛkaiḥ pratipāditāḥ niṣkalatvaṃ na tasyaiva śaktyāgrakalanā śrutaḥ kiñcitkālaṃ bhavenmuktiḥ pradhānaguṇabandhanāt rogamānandabhāvena vidyāhyarthavivekinī māyātmakamidaṃ devi adhobhāgapravartakam sakalaṃ vyāpayitvā tu saṃsthitaṃ tantu suvrate tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tadekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu narāṇāṃ nayane sūkṣme yogī nārāyaṇeśvaraḥ sa caiva paṭhyate taistu ṣaḍūrmirahitā tanuḥ asminneva śṛṇu devi ṣaḍūrmirahitaṃ yathā śaktinā rahitaṃ devi ṣaḍūrmirahitaṃ śivam neti neti ca haṃsākhyaṃ paramaṃ brahmavācakam idaṃ sā paramāmuktiḥ yā sā vedavido dhruvam ātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmānameva ca buddhimanye tathā devi pradhānaguṇagocaram baddhā vadanti bahavaḥ ṛṣayassaṃśitavratāḥ ṛṣayo yakṣarakṣāṃsi piśācoragakinnarāḥ siddhāścaiva tathā devi ye cānye bhuvi mānavāḥ sthūlātsthūlataraṃ devaṃ kalpayanti manīṣiṇaḥ

haritaṃ kapilañcaiva mañjiṣṭhaḥ sagareva ca śyāmaṃ tadulamāntrantu āpabaddhe ca puṣkare candrabiṃbanibhaṃ kecit ādityodayasannibham evaṃ bahuvidhaṃ deva sakalaṃ parameśvari asmātprabhūyate sarvamasminneva layaṃ punaḥ uttiṣṭhamāditaḥ kṛtvā vidveṣākarṣaṇaṃ tathā kiṃ tasya bahubhirmantraiḥ jñātaistu varavarṇinī yāge yāge jape home yathā sidhyanti yoginaḥ yāgasthaṃ sakalaṃ devaṃ śiraḥ pāṇyādilakṣaṇam evaṃ japaṃ tathā dhyāyan pūjayetparameśvaram cintyamānasya deveśe sarvavighnakṣayo bhavet yogakāle tathā devi dhyātavyaṃ sakalaṃ priye bindusthaṃ śabdalīnantu jyotīrūpaṃ śikhānvitam japakāle japaṃ kuryāt evaṃ sakalaniṣkalam bindudvayātparo devi sa vai niṣkalamucyate svāhākāra samāyuktaṃ homakāle tu homayet tayā homavikalpastu kartavyantu sadā budhaiḥ śāntyarthe vauṣaḍityevaṃ puṣṭyarthe namasuvauṣaṭ māraṇe tāḍane caiva icchā devi vicakṣaṇam evaṃ vijñāya kartavyaṃ japayogaṃ samādhinā sakalaṃ japamānastu niṣkalaṃ japitaṃ bhavet acirāddevi siddhyeta parameśena bhāṣitam kathitaṃ sa rahasyantu na mayā gopitaṃ tava anyāye pṛcchate yastu guruvutkrāntigocaram dharmaśīlavinītasya gurubhaktasya dhīmate

tasmācchreyārthibhirnityaṃ pūjanīyo gurussadā tithinakṣatrayogāśca itarānukūlameva ca pūrveṇa brahmaṇe kuryāt kṣatriyasyottareṇa tu brāhmaṇe madhurāsvādā kaṣāyā kṣatriyasya tu ājyagandhādvije bhūmīraktagandhā tu kṣatriye parīkṣya nipuṇo bhūmiṃ vārayogavidhānavit horāddrekkāṇi aṃśāśca tārā caiva balābalam yadi syāllaukiko devi kālajñānaṃ na jānati tatassaṃpūjya deveśaṃ lakṣayecca kramādbudhaḥ lakṣayitvā vidhānena ācāryassusamāhitaḥ gītavādyaravodghoṣaṃ jayaśabdasamanvitam bhaumānyetāni śabdāni antarikṣāḥ prakīrtitāḥ snigdhavidyullatāramyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śubham kākavṛddhacalolūkaśvānamārjārakūjitam eteṣāñcaiva yaśśabda praśastantu śobhane khātayejjānumātrantu pāṃsumuddhṛtya pūrayet jñātvā bhūmirvidhānajño vāstuyāgaṃ yajedbudhaḥ vāstuyāga smṛto hyeṣaḥ tato bhūmyāṃ viśodhanam secayetpañcagavyena tāṃ bhūmiṃ suparīkṣitām koṣṭayet sudṛḍhāṃ bhūmiṃ nimnonnatavivarjitām samaṃ sarvatra kartavyaṃ bhūmibhāgamidaṃ śubham puruṣāyā na kartavyamiṣṭakaṃ mṛṇmayañca vā evaṃ kṛtvā tato devi viṣṇubhūmiparigraham pañcāṅgañca śivaṃ yaṣṭvā juhuyādaṣṭaśataṃ kramāt pīṭhoṅkārasamāyuktaṃ pūjayeta gaṇeśvaram

bhūmyāṃ parigrahohyeṣa kathitaṃ tava śobhane saṃbhāraiḥ saṃbhṛto mantrī adhivāsanamārabhet evaṃ vinyasya yatnena śivākhyaṃ kalaśaṃ nyaset athavā mṛṇmayaṃ vāpi kārayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ su sugandhaistathā gandhaiḥ kaṇṭhasūtravibhūṣitam āsanaṃ kalpayettatra īśānyādiśamāśritam pañcabrahmā nyasetpūrvaṃ aṣṭattriṃśatkalāṃ tataḥ evaṃ vinyasya tatvāni tritatvāṃstu tridhā nyaset evaṃ vinyasya yatnena śivasyāvāhanaṃ kuru aghoreṇa tu sānnidhyamarghyaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tu hṛdaye hṛdayaṃ dadyāt śiraḥ śirasi vinyaset astraṃ hastapradeśe tu vinyasya parameśvari mantrātītaṃ paraṃ devaṃ tatvātītaṃ paraṃ padam astraṃ japtvā tato devi vikirān sarvato diśi gandhodakena saṃśodhya kalaśaṃ bhrāmayettataḥ acchinnodakadhārāntu dadyāt bāhye tu mantravit vardhanīmagrato gacchet kalaśaṃ tasya pṛṣṭataḥ bhrāmayitvā tato devi punastatraiva sthāpayet sthaṇḍilantu tato gacchet vidhinā pūjayettataḥ āgneyyāṃ diśi āśritya agnikuṇḍantu kārayet caturaṅgulamekaikā hrasvā hrasvatarā smṛtāḥ ullekhanantu tenaiva uddhṛtyābhyukṣayet punaḥ upalepite tu paścāt kuryādrekhopakalpanam ekā uttarataḥ kāryā dakṣiṇāyatamuttarā viṣṭaraṃ kuṇḍamadhye tu vāgīśvaryāḥ prakalpayet

tasmin tato mantrī ṛtumatīṃ vicintayet abhyarcya pañcabhirmantraiḥ vidyāṅgaiśca yathākramam tridhā kuṇḍantu taṃ bhrāmya hṛdayena vidhānavit garbhādhānaṃ pratimantrī sadyena tu tridhā hutiḥ arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tato dadyāt garbhādhānaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet rudrāṇyā tu trayaṃ dadyāt kṛtaṃ puṃsuvanaṃ bhavet trayo brahmaśireṇaiva arghyaṃ pādyaṃ tataḥ punaḥ vaktrodghāṭantu kuryādānupūrveṇa mantravit ekenaiva tu mantreṇa juhuyānnatra saṃśayaḥ āhutīnāṃ trayaṃ dadyāt vaktre vaktre na saṃśayaḥ udghāṭite tato vaktre jātakarmantu homayet astreṇaiva trayaṃ dadyāt āhutīnāṃ varānane jātakarma kṛte paścāt rakṣāṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ dakṣiṇe rudradevatyaṃ kalpayedviṣṭaropari uttareṇa śivasyaiva kalpayeta yathākramam īśānena tu hotavyaṃ nāmakarma vicakṣaṇaḥ hutvā hyevaṃ tato devī śivāgnirjanito bhavet saṃskāreṇa yadā śuddhaṃ agnimāhutya suvṛte sāṅgena devadevena pañcabrahmayutena ca tritatvaṃ vinyaset pūrvaṃ śivaṃ tattvāttu vinyaset yavagodhūmanīvāraiśśāliṣaṣṭikataṇḍalaiḥ madhyamaṃ pākasaṃyuktaṃ pācayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ cālanaṃ ghaṭṭanālepaṃ kuryādekādaśena tu ekādaśātmadevena juhuyādāhutitrayam vibhāgabhājitaṃ kṛtvā carukaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtam

tṛtīyaṃ sādhakebhyaśca pañcagavyapurassaram gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhisarpiḥ kuśodakam pañcagavyantu kartavyaṃ vidhinā'nena suvṛte ājyādhiśrayaṇaṃ kuryādudvāsyoplavanaṃ tataḥ nīrāyaṇaṃ tataḥ kuryāt ājyaśuddhiṃ vidhānavit saṃskāraiśśodhite ājye ājyabhāgantu homayet ājyabhāgavibhāgantu kathitaṃ tava śobhane ājyaśuddhividhirhyeṣaḥ kathitantu yathākramam sadyādi īśaparyantamekaikāhutayo hunet anena sarvakarmāṇi kartavyāni tu deśikaiḥ udvāsane tu gāyatrī utplavane viṣṇudaivatam avadyotasvaro jñeyo deśikena mahātmanā abhimantrya samantraistu śivaṃ tatraiva cintayet karmamantraprayogena adhidevaiśca saṃyutam āsanaṃ kalpayettatra vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā anantaṃ vinyasetpūrvaṃ dharmajñānaṃ tathaiva ca akāraṃ vinyaseddevi karṇikāyāṃ varānane hrasvoṅkārasamāyuktaṃ somamaṇḍalakalpitam ākāraṃ brahmadevatyamādityasyādhidaivatam ukāraṃ rudradaivatyamagnimaṇḍaladaivatam īśvareṇa samāyuktaṃ vinyaseta varānane nyasyā tu devadeveśi pañcabrahmāṇi vinyaset ātmatatve tu vaktavyamātmā tu parameśvari vāmadevena sadyena lakṣamātraṃ prakīrtitam aṅgapratyaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ kartavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ

pañcamūrdhānamīśena pūrvādārabhya mantrataḥ vaktre tatpuruṣasyaiva kalāni parikalpayet aghorasya kalāṃ devi hṛdayādivinirdiśet pṛṣṭhehyurasi mantrajña aghorasya kalā nyaset gude caiva tu liṅge ca ūrubhyāṃ jānunī tathā guhyāṅgakramayogena vāmadevakalā nyaset sadyojātakalā devi sadyaḥ sarvatra mūrtiṣu tatvānyaṣṭādaśaṃ devi navatatvānyathāpi vā pañcatatvāni vinyasya tritatvamupari nyaset āvāhite tato devi aṅgāni parikalpayet śikhāyāntu śikhāṃ dadyāt kavacaṃ sarvagātrakam āvāhayeta sadyena vāmadevena sthāpayet īśānena tu puṣpāṇi makuṭaṃ kuṇḍalāni ca aghoraṃ dakṣiṇenaiva vāmadevaṃ tathottare āgneyyāṃ hṛdayañcaiva īśānyāntu śiro nyaset astraṃ dvārapradeśe tu vinyaseta yathā budhaḥ anantaṃ pūrvato dadyāt sūkṣmaṃ dakṣiṇato nyaset ekanetrottareṇaiva vinyaseta sadā budhaḥ śrīkaṇṭhaṃ naiṛtenaiva śikhaṇḍiṃ vāyugocare tṛtīyāvaraṇaṃ devi śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te evaṃ vinyasya yatnena caturthe'strāṇi vinyaset pūrvoktena vidhānena kurvīta vidhivistaram pañcāṅgena samāyuktamardhacandrapurottare samayāṣṭakadoṣasya kṛtaṃ homaṃ mayā tava samayāṣṭakadoṣeṇa sādhakenaiva lipyate

pūjayettadguruṃ prājño yathā vibhavavistaraiḥ karṇikākaṭakeyūraiḥ pūjayeta sadā gurum nivedayettadātmānaṃ tadā tu ninṛṇo bhavet ṣaḍvidhaṃ yajate yastu ācāryaḥ susamāhitaḥ śivavatpūjayeddevi ācāryaṃ tatvapāragam veditavyaṃ prayatnena sādhakaistatvacintakaiḥ śarīre tāni sarvāṇi jñātavyāni vipaścitaiḥ nāsāṃ sañcārayogaṃ vai jñātavyaṃ tatvavedibhiḥ sañcāraṃ hyeṣa tatvānāṃ bhoktā bhojyaṃ tathaiva ca jñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa sādhakassavidhīyate vijñeyassa sadā tajjño uttarāyaṇamuttamam dakṣiṇāyanamityeva kathitaṃ tava suvṛte viṣuvaṃ sa tu vijñeyaṃ yogakālaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ādityaḥ sa tu vijñeyo jyeṣṭhā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā sāṃgratsthānaṃ sa vijñeyaṃ dakṣiṇena vyavasthitaḥ somasya tu sa tu jñeyo vāmā śaktiḥ prakīrtitā svapnasthānaṃ sa vijñeyaṃ vāmatastu vyavasthitam raudrī tantu vijānīyādicchāśaktiḥ prakīrtitāḥ tāmasantu vijānīyāt madhyame tu vyavasthitam bhūtaṃ brahma vijānīyāt bhaviṣyaṃ vaiṣṇave pade trikālamekato devi bindudevaṃ vyavasthitam tasyātītaṃ bhavonnādaṃ devadevaṃ sadāśivam pañcadhā pañcadevatyaṃ sakalaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitam brahmāṇamādhipatyena veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ jñātavyaṃ hi tatvajñaiḥ viṣṇustatrādhidaivatam

vijñeyaṃ tatsadā tajjñaiḥ rudrastatrādhidaivatam jñātavyantu varārohe īśastatrādhidaivatam etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa jñātavyaṃ deśikena tu jñātvā sarvamaśeṣeṇa ācāryassa vidhīyate vidyā rudrassamākhyātaḥ śāntirīśvara ucyate nādasyaiva krameṇaiva devatā kathitā mayā *? nāstu pañcamo jñeyo niṣkalastu sadāśivaḥ sūkṣmānyāyena mayā proktā devatā te prakīrtitāḥ jñātavyaṃ tatvato devi sādhakena mahātmanā sañcāraṃ kurute devi sa tu ātmā vijānataḥ tasmiṃstaistu samāyuktasañcaret parameśvaraḥ iṣṭasetsarvabhūteṣu tatvairyukto na saṃśayaḥ aviditvā na sidhyeta na ca yāti paraṃ padam bhagavan śrotumicchāmi bhoktā bhojyañca śaṅkara ko vā kṣipati garbhe tu grāsaṃ gṛhṇāti kaḥ prabho etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa kathayasva prasādataḥ yena vijñātamātreṇa annadoṣe na lipyate annaṃ brahmā raso viṣṇurbhoktā devo maheśvaraḥ yo vijānāti kartāraṃ bhoktā bhojyañca he priye tatvāni manasā cintya svaśarīre yathākramam dakṣiṇe śravaṇe caiva khamalaḥ parikīrtitaḥ sakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva nāsāyāṃ parikalpayet śūnyena paśyate cānnaṃ veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ brahmā ca viṣṇuśśravaṇe rudramīśvaracakṣuṣī nāsāśaktiṃ vijānīyādvaktre devaṃ sadāśivam

evaṃ tatvamayaṃ dhyātvā śivaṃ paramakāraṇam ṣaṇmukhenaiva yāgena bhuñjate satataṃ prabhuḥ khaṇḍakhādyaiśca bhuñjānaḥ kṣapaṇe gṛhṇate sadā ūrdhvamutkṣipate grāsanna vidyātkhamalaṃ kṛtam śūnyenaiva annādya granthete satataṃ punaḥ lehyaṃ śoṣyañca peyañca annāni vividhāni ca evaṃ tatvamayaṃ divyamācāryacchinnasaṃśayaḥ atha tatvavidaścaiva evaṃ bhuñjate priye atatvapratibuddhasya jñānine koṭirucyate dvijānāṃ vedaviduṣāṃ koṭiṃ saṃbhojya yatphalam bhojyaṃ māyātmakaṃ sarvaṃ kartā devo maheśvaraḥ evaṃ vai yo vijānāti deśikastatvapāragaḥ evaṃ bhojyavidhiṃ samyak na tu sarvatra vyāpayet evaṃ vai yo vijānīyādajñānīcānyathā bhavet ūrdhvena vahate prāṇa āpānodhaḥ pravartate tena bhuktena deveśe dātaroḍasya kulāni tu tadahaṃ śrotumicchāmi bhagavan vaktumarhasi puryaṣṭake yadāhyātmā vāyubhūto vyavasthitaḥ śrūyate yātanā tasya narakeṣu anekadhā tanubhūtaśśarīrātmā bhogān bhuñjati śaṅkara śṛṇu devi idaṃ guhyaṃ kathayāmi tavākhilam bhuñjate pūjitaṃ karma kathayāmi maheśvari puryaṣṭake yadāhyātmā vāyubhūto vyavasthitaḥ tridhāntaḥ karaṇaṃ devi tairna mucyetkṣaṇādapi tiṣṭhantamanutiṣṭheta dhāvantamanudhāvati

taistu yuktaṃ punardehaṃ saṃprapadye varānane akasmājjāyate dehaṃ kṣaṇamātreṇa śobhane bhūtātmakaṃ tadā dehaṃ jāyate paramāṇubhiḥ tārādyaṃ jñānajaṃ vāpi akṛtādyādidehajam narake ca varārohe yātanā tu pṛthagvidhā brahmaviṣṇvātmakā bhūtā rudrātmā īśvarātmakāḥ viṣayāścaiva teṣveva jñātavyāni varānane tasmāttu devadeveśe nyaseddevi sadāśive sanyāsa eṣa vikhyātaḥ śivena paramātmanā brahmāṇamāditaḥ kṛtvā devaiśca sahasaṃyutaḥ pūrvamādikrameṇaiva śabdādīnāṃ yathākramam evaṃ hute śate devi pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayet rasaṃ vai vinyasedviṣṇoḥ rūpaṃ gandhastathaiva ca ahaṅkārastathā buddhirīśvare tantu vinyaset nyaste puryaṣṭake devi pūrṇāhutyā tu pātayet pūrṇāhutyā tu deveśi pātayet susamāhitaḥ sadāśivasya tatvasya nidhanena tu homayet sakalādikrameṇaiva grāhakāḥ parikīrtitāḥ dīkṣā pañcavidhā devi kathitā tu samāsataḥ tatra śudhyenna śudhyeta viśeṣaḥ kathito mayā samayabhede hetvarthe antyeṣṭintu samārabhet evaṃ saṃhārayogena huneccaiva yathākramam samayācāradoṣasya pramādātskhalitasya ca athavā mātṛkādhvānaṃ kṣakārādi samāsataḥ ekaikena tu varṇena homayeta vicakṣaṇaḥ

tena pūrṇāhutiṃ dadyādantyeṣṭintu samarpayet antyeṣṭiḥ śudhyate caiva prāyaścittādviśudhyate sarvājñā laṅghane caiva antyeṣṭi homayettataḥ kālacakravidhānajñaḥ kālajñassa vidhīyate kasmātpravartate kālaḥ kathaṃ kālo nigadyate yena sañcodyamānastu kālaḥ kalayate prabho laukikādhyātmikañcaiva kathaṃ vijñāyate prabho vināvināvayaścaiva muhūrtānāṃ tathaiva ca ghaṭikānāṃ samākhyā hi tatvānāñca yathākramam laukikādhyātmikañcaiva kathayasva prasādataḥ tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yatsurairapi durlabham yathā vai jñāyate devi laukikaṃ kālamuttamam etatkālavidhānajño labhate śāśvataṃ padam laukikādhyātmikaṃ kālaṃ yo vetti nikhilena tu śubhāśubhañca deveśe lokasyaiva hitāhitam kālacakraṃ samākhyātamādityāt saṃpravartate ṛturmāsastathā pakṣo gṛhaṛkṣātharāśayaḥ aṃśāssandhyastathā tārā horāddrekkāṇayastathā sa eṣa kathitaḥ kālaḥ laukikaḥ parameśvari tathā te kathayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvāyatalocane bhāskareṇa samāssarve rāśayaśca na saṃśayaḥ grahān patreṣu saṃsthāpya pūrvādidalasaṃsthitān gṛhacakraṃ smṛto hyeṣa jñātavyaṃ kālavedinā rajaputraṃ nyaseddevi dakṣiṇe susamāhitaḥ bṛhaspatiṃ nyasennityaṃ paścime susamāhitaḥ

ketumīśānasthāpya tato mantrāḥ prakalpayet sakalaṃ niṣkalañcaiva śūnyatatvaṃ tathaiva ca kaṇṭhoṣṭhyañcaiva deveśe gṛhāhyete prakīrtitāḥ parākṣaraṃ paraṃ devaṃ brahmasthānena vinyaset karṇike devatānyāsaṃ kartavyaṃ kālavedinā sakalādikrameṇaiva kathayāmi samāsataḥ ete prāṇā smṛtā devi vibhajeta yathākramam śatāni saptavijñeyamekaikasya varānane patre patre tu saṃsthāpya gṛhān sarvān varānane dīptāṅgāriṇi dhūmā ca sthānatrayamudāhṛtam ātmanā saha saṃyuktaḥ karṇikāsthaḥ prabhu smṛtaḥ raudramāgneyadigbhāge śāntiṃ vai dakṣiṇena tu vāyavyāṃ kṣipranāśāya dhanalābhāya cottare śāntike pauṣṭike caiva evamādikrameṇa tu aśubhamekataḥ proktaṃ dvitīyasmin śubhaṃ vadet tadgṛhaṃ pūjayennityaṃ karṇikāsthaṃ yadā budhaḥ ekaikasya gṛho devi horātrāṇi prakīrtitāḥ ekaikasya tu horāyāṃ śatāni navasaṃkhyayā etatte cāramākhyātaṃ śivena paramātmanā gṛhahorabalenaiva vaktavyantu śubhāśubham evaṃ balābalaṃ jñātvā ātmanasya parasya vā dehasthaṃ kathitaṃ devi horacāramanuttamam rāśau rāśau yadāhyātmā carate kathayāmyaham akāraḥ prathamo devi meṣarāśiḥ prakīrtitaḥ tatrasthaścarate hyātmā yathāvattannibodhame

eṣa cāraḥ samākhyātaḥ rāśau rāśau na saṃśayaḥ yatpatre paśyate doṣaṃ tanmāse doṣamādiśet kṣemamārogyārthalābhaṃ vadate kālayogavit tadrekkāṇe nave rāśau cāraṃ teṣāṃ dadāmyaham ekaikodayasthāvajñaḥ sidhyate nātra saṃśayaḥ uttiṣṭhe cādadhāne ca pādalepe'ñjane tathā gṛhoparāgavanmāse hṛtpadme tu sa paśyati śubhāśubhantu drekkāṇaiḥ kathayeta varānane aṃśādrekkāṇahoraiśca ekaikasya samāsataḥ tāracandrabalenaiva śubhāśubhaṃ na saṃśayaḥ vadate yoginaḥ śrīmān lokasyaiva hitāhitam sahasradvayaṃ vijñeyaṃ śatāni catureva tu tārāṇāṃ yāvatī saṃkhyā aṃśānāṃ tāvatī smṛtāḥ jñānena mucyate devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ātmā tu kathitaḥ kāla īśvarassa tu kathyate ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi kālacakramanuttamam tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yāthātathyena me śṛṇu kalā tu devadeveśe ṣoḍaśaiva tu vinyaset tathā cakradhṛtikarī saumarī cicchubhaṃ tathā daśapañca kalā jñeyā amṛtā caiva ṣoḍaśī jvālinī tu śamā dhūmrā kāmadā vijayā tathā tālujihvopajihvā ca tathā jihvāvahā ca yā ṣoḍaśaitāssamākhyātāḥ marutādiralaṅkṛtā vepathussaṃbhramaścaiva vibhramo bhrama eva ca ṛṣayo nāgakūrmaśca ṣoḍaśaite mahānilāḥ

bibhajya kathayetprāṇān kalādīnāṃ yathākramam śatatrayañca jñātavyaṃ prāṇāḥ pañcāśadeva tu ekodayena jñātavyaṃ deśikena mahātmanā ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi ṛkṣeṣu camare yathā śatāni sapta vijñeyāḥ * *? prāṇāstathaiva ca lavamekañca jñātavyaṃ kālajñena mahātmanā aṃśādhvā daśamākhyātā ṛkṣāṇāṃ varavarṇinī ebhyaścarati ātmā tu kathayāmi samāsataḥ yathā carati viśvātmā śṛṇuṣva kathayāmi te prāṇā dvādaśa vijñeyā nimeṣadvaya saṃyutam dvā navati śataikantu prāṇasaṃkhyā prakīrtitāḥ tṛṭe śṛṅgāgramākhyātaṃ jñātavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ aśīti caturaṃśantu sarvatra parikīrtitam kṛttikādiṣu ratneṣu jñātavyaṃ kālavedinā yasyai tacchubhaṛkṣeṇa vīcāyāṃ vrajate naraḥ na tasya aśubhaṃ kiñcit vyābhīcyāṃ vrajate tu yaḥ ahorātreṇa jñātavyaṃ kālajñena mahātmanā dine dine sthiredyastu idaṃ cakraṃ samādhinā naiva puṇyaṃ bhavettasya naiva pāpaṃ kathañcana ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi phalasaṃkhyā yathaiva ca viduṣāṇi tathā ṣaṣṭiṃ bindurekaṃ pracakṣate phalasya eṣā saṃkhyoktā kālaṃ vai laukikasya tu taruṇasya pradhānasya niruddhaḥ prāṇinaḥ sa tu ṣaṣṭimirvī nāḍyekā ghaṭikā kathitā tu sā muhūrtā striṃśadākhyātā ahorātravido viduḥ

etānyekaiva saṃkhyātaṃ mātasya surasundari dvādaśe gaṇitaṃ māsaṃ saṃvatsaramihocyate sahasrāṇi daśaproktā stathāhyaṣṭaśatāni tu muhūrte navaye devi tathaiva kathayāmi te eṣacāraṃ mayā proktaṃ veditavyaṃ hitaiṣibhiḥ trikālaviṣayaṃ tasya jāyate jāpinasya tu ghaṭikā pañcadeveśe akārasyodayasmṛtaḥ laukikaṃ praharañcaiva ṣaṭbhāgaṃ parikīrtitam dakṣiṇe tāvatī jñeyā kālajñena mahātmanā udayaṃ prathamo devi rāśibhiḥ kathitastava makaraḥ kuṃbhamīnañca meṣañca vṛṣabhastathā karkaṭassiṃha kanyaśca tulāvṛścikameva ca māsi māsi samākhyāto yathāvacchṛṇu suvrate māsi māsi samākhyāto yathāvattava śobhane yāvantaṃ kramate devi madhye tu viṣuvaṃ smṛtam indriyārthaṃ parityajya vyomāvastho bhavedyadā yadā ūrdhvatvamāyāti devadevo jagadguruḥ adhobhāge smṛtā rātriḥ madhye tu ayanaṃ bhavet hikkāmudāhṛtā cikkā aṣṭadhā tu krameṇa tu ṛṇastu bhavate kasso niśvāso dhana ucyate evañcāravidhānajño labhate śāśvataṃ padam cārasaṃyogayogena ātmānamupacaryate sakālaṃ kalpanāmantu śaktināṃ parameśvari akālakalamityuktaṃ vādino'pi dvidhoddhṛtam nityāvasthamidaṃ kālaṃ brahmādīnāṃ varānane

nityāvastho'nyathā kālaḥ kena tadupacaryate cāreṇa jñāyate kālaṃ cārāt siddhirna saṃśayaḥ tasmāccāramidaṃ devi veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ na kālajñassa vijñeyo bhavennakṣatra sūcakaḥ veditavyaṃ prayatnena kālajñaissa tu vedibhiḥ anena upacāreṇa laukikamupacaryate nityaṃ nityasthito devi svayaṃ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ evaṃ kālamiti proktaṃ sarvataḥ saṃpravartate tvanmukhāmṛtasārantu pītaṃ jñānāmṛtaṃ mayā śrutametanmayā sarvaṃ tvatprasādāt sudurlabham āyuḥ pramāṇaṃ yadbhogaṃ manujānāṃ maheśvara utpannasya vināśo'sti kṛtireṣā tu kīrtitāḥ atra mṛtyusamīpasthaṃ kathaṃ vijñāyate prabho sādhu sādhu punassādhu praśnametatsudurlabham yathā cāsannamṛtyustu jāyate tu parasya tu yena yena ca cihnena lakṣyate tu śṛṇuṣva me ṛkṣācakraṃ gṛhaiścaiva aṅgāriṣṭā viparyayāt bahirliṅgāni vakṣyāmi samāsāttu varānane tatraiva koṣṭhe koṣṭhe tu likhennakṣatramaṇḍalam rikṣātrayasmṛto janma tathā saṃpadviparyayau maitraṃ paramamaitrañca tārācakraṃ śubhāśubham ādhānaṃ karma janmaistu bhaumādityaśanaiścaraiḥ ete grahā viruddhāstu sa naro hi hatoddhṛvam saumyadvaye kapālastha saṃpadastu pade pade yathā janmatraye devi krūrāssaumyaśubhāśubhāḥ

pāpaghnāssaṃpadasthāssyupīpatsthā padakārakāḥ vidyāsiddhiñca kāryañca sādhakasya bhavanti te maitre tu maitratāṃ kuryuḥ yadyasyānyāpi krauryatā saumyāḥ śubhaṃ prayacchanti ekadvitriguṇodayāḥ evaṃ gṛhagatiṃ budhvā ātmanaśca parasya vā aṅgāriṣṭaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi yathā sphuṭam skandho'pi vakratāmeti vināśaṃ vatsarāntike sitaṃ haritakṛṣṇañca vatsarārdhāyuṣo hi saḥ suṣumṇāntārakājyoti so'pi ṣāṇmāsikāyuṣaḥ paśyate vā śiracchāyāṃ ṛtutrayaṃ sa jīvati kharoṣṭrayānamāsīnagṛdhrakākaśivādibhiḥ svapne ca lapsyate caiva so daikaṃ yadi jīvati yadā niṣpandatāṃ yāti so'vaśyaṃ vadhamāpnuyāt na paśya* * *? dhānaṃ so'vaśyaṃ mriyate naraḥ alpāyurnaiva paśyeta nāsikāgranthi vā smṛtam paśyedarkasomamaṇḍalaṃ caturmāsāyuṣo hi saḥ na tu paśyati mūḍhātmā ṛtumekaṃ sa jīvati atibhīto'ti saṃ* * *? rṣamekāyuṣo hi saḥ puruṣañcābhimukhaṃ svapne ṛtudhyā * * * *? anuṣṇañca bhavedgātraṃ dvaumāsāyurgatāyuṣaḥ dṛṣṭe deśe'pi digdāho māsatrayaparāyuṣaḥ gandhamāghrāti cāṇdhānya * * *? vigatāyuṣaḥ varṇañca vividhāṅgeṣu udayaṃ rudate sakṛt nābhijñāya śrījihvaṃ dīpamāghrāni pāṣiṣā *? hikkā * * *? te nityaṃ vaktrarandhrānugo marut

evaṃ vidhairbahuliṅgaiḥ boddhavyaṃ mṛtyucoditaiḥ idaṃ trinetra saṃproktaṃ yogino bhāskarodaye tato yogī śucirbhūtvā dhīro yogāsane sthitaḥ apramattassadā tiṣṭhet yukto nādaikatāṃ gataḥ navaśaktīti saṅkrānti kāle vai kalayetsadā ye tu saṅkrāntike prāṇā suṣumnā tu sthito vahet ahorātreṇa cābdaikaṃ yogī jīvitumicchami **? rabdantu vijñeyañcaturbhiścaturabdikam ṣaṭsaptāṣṭadine vyūḍhe tāvadvarṣāṇi jīvati kadācicchakaleśānaḥ saptapraharanirgamam pañcakohyardha * * *? caturbhirmāsajīvinaḥ praharadvayaṃ tathā vyūḍhaṃ dinānyaṣṭau sa jīvati praharārdhaṃ vahedyasya sa jīvati dinadvayam yaṃ vā kālaṃ samāruhya pravahet * * * * ? yam uttarāyaṇaje kāle kathitaṃ tava śobhane śrotramārgakṛtāṅguṣṭhau ghoṣaṃ na śṛṇute naraḥ kāravam utpādyañca tathākarṇya mṛtyuyogaṃ tathaiva ca yogī vaktrāntanivahaṃ kālasaṅkrāntipañcakam dravyahānirmanodvegaṃ kuryādrogavivardhanam nāsikādakṣiṇapuṭe dakṣiṇāyanajīvite vāmaghrāṇapuṭāntasthaṃ saṅkrāntyāhyaṣṭapañcakam nīroga pramehañca mūtrakṛcchrakāpayet yatkāle vahate vāyuḥ tatkāle divase pare atordhvasparśabhaṃ lakṣaṃ nāsādhastāttu **? ri

dakṣiṇe dakṣiṇe sparśi vā *? krośaparābhavam sāṅkrāntyeko bahudhā pravahante itastataḥ yadā tu mandaṃ cārisyānnibījasthā samāśritaḥ * *? rakavicchedānmāsaikaikantu chanda * * ? divasaikaikavicchedādyāvattriṃśatsamāgatāḥ samādiśet suṣamnā dakṣiṇe prāṇe tadvahe caiva * * *? trirucchvāsava *? tābhyāṃ te caiva viṣuvāyanam iḍayāntarmahādevi rāśayo di * * * * ? makaramādisaṅkrāntyai kaikeyā budhaḥ vijñeyaḥ prāṇavikṣepaḥ prabudhyante ca te kramāt pra* * * ? matikālaṃ samīparārdhakalpitam prāṇāṣṣaṣṭissamākhyātā prāṇāścaikādaśaṃ punaḥ kṛttikādyā bhaveccāraṃ bharaṇyāntāni moditāḥ jñātvā yogī japenmṛtyuṃ dhyātvā de* *? lakṣaram nāḍikāgrahasaṃstho hi kālaḥ kalayate prabhuḥ śaṃbhumambujapādañca bījaṃ kāleśvaraṃ sthitam tadā pravartate tasya trikālajñānamuttamam ṣaṇmāsābhyantare yuktaḥ kālajñānaṃ pravartate kālātmā japato devi yato vā vā maheśvari hatamṛtyujarārohi sarvarogavivarjitaḥ jāyate nātra sandeho yogī kālajayeṣiṇaḥ jāyate yoginassarvaṃ kālamṛtyurmahadbhayam mantraṃ vā japate yastu pañcākṣaraṃ mahāmatiḥ japato mantrarājānaḥ oṃ jṛṃsaśśivāya namaḥ

nānena sadṛśo mantraḥ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate pūjitaṃ tridaśaihyetaṃ mantrarājaṃ sudurlabham pañcamaṃ devadeveśaṃ sadāśivaṃ paraṃ padam hutañca satataṃ taistu mṛtyujit sa tu te surāḥ jarārogavinirmuktāḥ paramaiśvaryasamanvitāḥ nirdvandvā nirahaṃkārāḥ pralaye bhinnadehajāḥ etanmantravaraṃ prāpyātmānaṃ paṭhate sadā ātmānaṃ prākṛtaṃ tatvaṃ antarātmā tu pauruṣam ātmā tu karmaṇaḥ kartā'ntarātmā tu kārakaḥ aṇimādiguṇairyuktaḥ paramātmā maheśvaraḥ mokṣaṃ jānanti yogīnāṃ vyākhyātaṃ tava śobhane oṅkāravākyarūpeṇa brahmavidyāvadanti hi satvaṃ rajastamaścaiva guṇatrayamudāhṛtam ṛgyajussāmavedāśca trayo vedāssa eva tu ānandaṃ paramaṃ brahma sāmyāvasthaṃ tamomayam mṛtpiṇḍadaṇḍapāṣāṇannissukhaṃ niṣpracetanam adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi sādaraṃ śṛṇu suvṛte pradyumnamaniruddhañca tathā saṅkarṣaṇo mahān pradyumnakārako nāma kāmo vai kāmarūpiṇaḥ saṅkarṣaṇo bhavedbuddhiḥ prāṇāpānamayī purī guṇasāmye sthitā yasmāt nirvikalpe nirāmayaḥ pradhānakimahorātramuṣitvā prāṇinastathā vasante sarvabhūteṣu svabhāvaguṇavāsanā nāsau devadeveti paṭhyate pāñcarātrake jāgratsvapnasuṣuptākhyaiḥ satvarājasatāmasaiḥ

teṣāṃ yasturyanāmānaṃ tasyādhaḥ prakṛtisthitā etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ kiṃ bhūyaḥ paripṛcchasi vaimalānāṃ dhruvaṃ devaṃ kārakāṇāṃ tatopari teṣāṃ tatparamaṃ sthānaṃ dīkṣādhvānaviśodhitam caryādhvānaviśuddhātmā gacchate nātra saṃśayaḥ jīvākhye niyataṃ devamupāsyante nātra saṃśayaḥ nyāyavaiśeṣikāścaiva naiśreyapadavādinaḥ purāṇe kavirityevaṃ puruṣaṃ parameśvaram ekadhā bahudhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā bahubhirnāmabhedaistu ṛṣibhiḥ parigīyate prāṇinaḥ kecidityevaṃ pudgalaṃ paśureva hi ātmānamantarātmānaṃ paramātmā tathā pare ataḥ paratareṇaiva pātālāni yathākramam ābhāsatālasutālañca śrītālañcagabhastikam eteṣāmupariṣṭāttu bhuvanāssapta kīrtitāḥ caturdaśavidhaścaiva yasmin saṃsāramaṇḍalam brahmāṇamāditaḥ kṛtvā paiśācāntantu śobhane pakṣiṇaśca tathā proktā tathā caiva sarīsṛpaḥ caturdaśavidhaṃ devi jñeyaṃ saṃsāramaṇḍalam mānuṣyeṣu punaḥ paścāt jātiruddharaṇaṃ smṛtaḥ vaiśyakṣatraṃ tathā brahmajātiruddharaṇaṃ kuru garbhādhānāditaḥ kṛtvā antyeṣṭintu paścimam kratubhiśśuddhadehe tu bhūloke tu niyojayet janastapastathā satyaṃ krameṇa punaruddharet rudrāsanaṃ tathā proktaṃ brahmāṇḍābhyantare tathā

agnikumārakāścaiva mayaścaiva balistathā balohyatibalaścaiva balavān balavikramaḥ etaissapta samākhyātāḥ bhuvanīśā mahābalāḥ śarvo rudrastathā bhīmo bhava ugrastathaiva ca kāpālīśopyajo buddho vajradehapramardanaḥ daśarudrāssamākhyātā pūrvāyāḥ diśi saṃsthitāḥ jvalano dahano babhruḥ bhasmāntakaḥ kṣayāntakaḥ yo dhūmraharo dhātā vidhātā karta eva ca saṃyoktā ca viyoktā ca ityete kathitā mayā naiṛto māraṇo hantā krūradṛṣṭirbhayānakaḥ naiṛte daśarudrāstu kathitāhyanupūrvaśaḥ śveto'tha jayabhadraśca dīrghabāhurjalāntakaḥ vāruṇyāṃ daśarudrāstu kathitā hyanupūrvaśaḥ pañcāntakaḥ pañcaśikhaḥ kapardī meghavāhanaḥ nidhīśo rūpavāndhanyaḥ saumyadeho jaṭādharaḥ uttarāṃ diśamāśritya daśarudrā mahābalāḥ sureśvaraśca sarveśo bhūtapālo balipriyaḥ īśānyāṃ daśarudrāstu kathitā hyanupūrvaśaḥ ugraseno'dhivīraśca phaṇīndro vajradaṃṣṭravān śaṃbhurvibhurguṇādhyakṣaḥ stryakṣastridaśavanditaḥ ūrdhvāṃ diśaṃ samāśritya daśarudrā mahābalāḥ sthāvaraṃ prathamaṃ śodhyaṃ tataśśedhyaṃ sarīsṛpam devayonirpunaśśodhya evameva vipaścitaiḥ antyajaḥ prathamaṃ proktaśśūdraśca tadanantaram sadyādivaktraparyantaiśśodhayeta yathākramam

dhyeyañca vividhaṃ yattadvidyāṅgaiśśodhayet kramāt garbhādhānaṃ puṃsavanaṃ sīmantaṃ jātakarmaṇi cūḍopanayanañcaiva vṛtabandhaṃ tathaiva ca **? magnirupāsañca vratāni punareva tu gaṇeśvaraṃ caturthantu uttamañcādhisākakam aiṣṭikaṃ dārthakañcaiva bhautikaṃ saumikaṃ tathā godānantu tataḥ kṛtvā patnīsaṃyojanaṃ tathā caitrī cāśvayujī caiva pākayajñāḥ prakīrtitāḥ paurṇamāsīti vijñeyā sautrāmaṇī tataḥ param agniṣṭomotyagniṣṭomamuthyayajñaktṛtīyakaḥ trirātraṃ ṣaṣṭamityuktaṃ aptoryāmañca saptamaḥ hiraṇyapādaḥ prathamo hiraṇyaguhyamataḥ param hiraṇyagarbhastathā proktā pañcamaḥ parameśvari hiraṇyatvak samākhyātaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathā'ṣṭamam āsahasrasya yajñasya daśayajñāḥ paraḥ smṛtāḥ daśayajñopariṣṭāttu aśvamedhantu homayet pārivrājyaṃ tato yojya antyeṣṭintu tato hunet puryaṣṭakasamāyuktaṃ paścāttatveṣu yojayet buddhirguṇastathā'vyaktaṃ kramaśaḥ kathayāmite aṣaḍiñcaiva daṇḍiñca bhārabhūtiñca lākulam hariścandraśśrīśailaṃ jalpeśvaramataḥ param kedāraṃ bhairavañca atiguhyāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam vimalañcāṭṭahāsañca mahendraṃ bhīmamaṣṭamam vastrāpadaṃ rudrakoṭimavimuktaṃ mahālayam pavitrāṣṭakametaddhi kathitaṃ hyanupūrvaśaḥ

kālañjaravanañcaiva śaṅkukarṇaṃ sthaleśvaram sthānāṣṭakamidaṃ jñeyaṃ ahaṅkāre vyavasthitam saumyantvatha prajeśañca brāhmañcaivāṣṭamaṃ smṛtam saṃvarta ekavīraśca kṛtānto jananāśanaḥ ete krodheśvarāḥ proktāḥ anupūrvaṃ yathākramam lokādhyakṣagaṇādhyakṣaṃ tridaśe tripurāntakam tejoṣṭakaṃ samākhyātaṃ anupūrveṇa te mayā akṛtañca kṛtañcaiva bhairavaṃ brāhmameva ca yoginaḥ kathitā hyete yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ īśvaro'tha ajeśaśca anantaikaśivastathā suśivādupariṣṭāttu vīrabhadraḥ prakīrtitaḥ vāmadevodbhavaścaiva tathā caiva bhavodbhavaḥ aṅguṣṭhamātrasahitā mahādevāṣṭakaṃ smṛtam mahendro dinakṛccaiva pradodakṣaṇa eva ca kaṇṭhaghaṇṭā bṛhantā ca nādāśveta eva ca ācāryaśśivarūpaśca jyeṣṭhe nārāyaṇastathā gahaneśaḥ pīḍanaścaiva * *? paṅktiriṣyate akṣasūtra ekapādañca tathā gṛdhraśiveśvaraḥ ṛṣabhaścaiva gokarṇaḥ tathā devo guheśvaraḥ ugro bhasmaśśikhī śūlī sugītiśca tathaiva hi tathā tridaṇḍī śavanaṃ sājyaṃ lakulīśaṃ tathaiva ca devā caraṇā dīrghaṃ vā haribhūścaiva yathākramam sadyojātastathā ruṇḍī ṣaṇmukhaścaturānanaḥ meṣasaṃvartakaścaiva bhasmeśaḥ kāmanāśanaḥ budhyā ghrāṇendriyaḥ prokto pṛthivyānte

āpe tu rasatanmātraṃ viṣayaṃ rasameva ca āpe tu śodhanīyā tu anupūrvaṃ yathākramam karmendriya smṛtaḥ pādaḥ budhyā cakṣuḥ prakīrtitaḥ vāyau tu sparśatanmātraṃ viṣayaṃ sparśasaṃjñitam vāyutatve tu saṃśodhyā anupūrveṇa deśikaḥ karmendriyaṃ smṛto vācā badhvā śrotrendriya smṛtaḥ romāṇi lohitaṃ māṃsaṃ mātṛkartṛka ucyate annapānaṃ manaścaiva krameṇa parikīrtitāḥ śodhanīyaṃ yathānyāyaṃ prakṛtyāyāntu yā vidhī gurupaṅktitrayaṃ hutvā pradhānantu tato hunet pauruṣe caiva tatve tu kathayāmyanu pūrvaśaḥ sutārā ca supārā ca sunetrā ca tathaiva hi tārādyā adhunā vakṣye prāpyamāna nibodhame pramodā pramuditā caiva modamānā tathaiva ca siddhiraṣṭavidhā khyātā jñātavyā deśikena tu prākāmyamīśitatvañca vaśitvañca tathaiva hi eteṣāmupariṣṭāttu nāḍyo vidyāṣṭakaṃ hunet mālā ca mālinī caiva svahā caiva svadhā tathā ata eva upariṣṭāttu kathitaṃ vigrahāṣṭakaṃ kāryañca kāraṇañcaiva sukhaṃ duḥkhaṃ tathaiva ca anye ye kathitā devi bhuvanādhvena ye purā sukhapāśo duḥkhapāśantu śuklakṛṣṇāvubhāvapi vāmadevodbhavaścaiva tathā caiva bhavodbhavaḥ dhātāraḥ kramaśaścaiva vikramaśca tathaiva ca niyatyāṃ saṃsthitā hyete daśarudrāssamāsataḥ

ramākṣaraḥ ? daśaite tu samākhyātā anupūrvaṃ yathākramam nāḍītrayamidaṃ devi yā proktāstatra yo'kṣarāḥ icchājñānakriyā caiva paraṃ śaktitrayaṃ smṛtam gārhapatyo dakṣiṇāgnirāhavanīyaṃ tṛtīyakam guṇatrayantu traireva padatrayamudāhṛtam īśvaraṃ hi caturthantu pañcamantu sadāśivam eṣa sarvamayo devi mantraṃ paramadurlabham japatastṛptimāyāti amṛtīśasamo bhavet kathitaṃ sarahasyantu kālacakraṃ samāsataḥ dhyāyate satataṃ yastu amṛtaṃ mṛtyunāśanam tadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi tatsamāsena me śṛṇu tannāma patayaścaiva āvīcī rauravaṃ tathā śīta uṣṇastathaiveha sañjīvasujīvanam sūcīmukhaṃ tathā proktaṃ jvaravarāsīparvatam aṃbarīṣaṃ tathā proktaṃ aṅgārarāśimataḥ param sa kṛmiśca tathā proktaṃ mīnodaravarodaraḥ vajragrīvo mahākāyo kālaṃ vai vaḍavāmukham tathāpūya hṛdañcaiva bhramarāmaśakastathā karkaṭaṃ kṛkacañcaiva garbhaṃ caiva tathāparam śatānanaṃ pañcamukhaṃ jaṃbūkaṃ punareva hi hunañca hunahastañca paraśuddhadhvameva ca dāvāgniraparūpaśca āpako madhyameva ca laṃboṣṭhaḥ kūpaśākhaśca bahuśākhastathaiva ca gaviherasmaraśyā ca lohapañcarameva ca

kavāṭasaṅkulaścaiva krimivaitaraṇī tathā vakranāśaśca vividhaḥ khañjarīṭakameva ca śivānādaṃ gajanādaṃ mahānādaṃ tathaiva ca mūṣikaṃ ghorarūpañca kṛṣṇavartamadhaḥ śiraḥ ikṣu yantrañca aśani tathā gaṇḍodara smṛtaḥ eteṣāṃ bhuvanā raudrā strikoṇāḥ parikīrtitāḥ manonmanassamākhyātastathā ca sumanonmanaḥ rāgatatvasamākhyātaśśodhanīyā vidurbadhaiḥ mahābalāḥ pravaro medhātithiścaivacchedako dahanastathā vāmājjyeṣṭhādayastatra śodhanīyā vipaścitaiḥ suśivaśca śivaścaiva kathitā anupūrvaśaḥ mado moho mahāmohaḥ coṣavaicitryameva ca ata ūrdhvantu oṅkāraṃ veditavyaṃ prayatnataḥ dhyānāhāraṃ samākhyātaṃ bhasmeśaṃ tadanantaram pañcārthaguhyakañcaiva rudrāṅkuśamataḥ param ākarṣakassamākhyāto mayā tatvasya madhyataḥ kathitaṃ sarvavidyānāṃ yonibhūtaṃ mahādhiyā tathā balavikāraṇī balapramathinī * * ? atordhvaṃ īśvaraṃ tatvaṃ veditavyaṃ samāhitaḥ ekanetraikarudraśca trimūrtiścānaladyutiḥ * * * ? ntu pravakṣyāmi rūpacatuṣṭayaṃ tathā ata ūrdhvantu deveśi śaktayastrīṇi kīrtitāḥ paśoryojanaviśeṣa uddhāre ca prakīrtitāḥ upariṣṭāttu dve vidye veditavyāḥ prayatnataḥ

jñānasamanvitāḥ eteṣāmupariṣṭāttu punaśca praṇavasmṛtaḥ eteṣāmupariṣṭāttu saumyaṃ rū anupūrvaśaḥ dhruvañcaivopariṣṭāttu rudraikādaśakaṃ punaḥ gulake saṃsthitā hyete veditavyāḥ prayatnataḥ icchāśakti tatordhve tu ūrdhvaṃ prītyādayasmṛtāḥ kathitaṃ te samāsena aṣṭau te bhuvaneśvarāḥ parato'nyaghano nāma rudroṅkāramataḥ param parivāryo'ṣṭabhedena madhye nādastu saṃsthitaḥ nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyāśāntistathaiva ca kasmin * * *? ddha jñeyaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpya vyavasthitam tato brahmabile līnā padmasūtranibhā sthitā ato * * * * * * ? nirālaṃbo tatopari tasmin yukto yadāhyātmā tattulyasamatāṃ vrajet
